This energy condensates itself and gives birth to a new entity that is totally moved by the emotion the person was feeling during their death, and while they may have memories of the person whose death gave origin to them, they are independent entities with their own will, and sometimes, they might even develop their own consciousness and identity apart from the person. The Specters are the very embodiment of the emotions felt by the person in the moment of their death. As the Specters are born from sheer emotion, this emotion is also their sustain, and they need more and more to strength themselves and survive, otherwise, they will dissolve and cease to exist. (late-girlfriend)}} '''Jack Kline''' (b. May 18, 2017) is the son of [[Lucifer]] and [[Kelly Kline|Kelly Kline]]. He is the first and only known [[Nephilim]] to be sired by an [[Archangels|Archangel]]. Jack was taken in by [[Sam Winchester|Sam]] and [[Dean Winchester]] who would teach him how to master his powers. During this time, Jack played a role in the resurrection of [[Castiel]] who he had chosen as his father.
Jack would leave the Winchesters and Castiel to go off to master his powers, in an effort to prove he is good he would search for a way to rescue Mary Winchester for her sons. Jack would be sent to [[Apocalypse World]] where he'd rescue Mary and they fight out off many angels to protect a human colony.

Wanting to free the Apocalypse World from Michael's reign, Jack would form a resistance composed of humans to stand against the angels.

In the months that followed, Jack would see many victories over the angels before he was reunited with Sam, Dean, and Castiel. Jack also met his biological father Lucifer and his uncle [[Gabriel]]. He was unsure of how to deal with this but decided to hear his father out and even got on good terms with him. Jack believed that with his father, he could defeat Michael. However, his close status with Lucifer raised concern from the Winchesters and they soon put a stop to it in the evacuation of Apocalypse world by leaving Lucifer trapped.

=== Early History ===
Cassiel was one of the last two angels to be created by [[God (Between Angels and Demons)|God]], along with her twin brother, with neither of the two, or even the other angels, being able to tell who is the younger. Cassiel became a close friend of [[Anna Milton (Between Angels and Demons)|Ananiel]], [[Samandriel (Between Angels and Demons)|Samandriel]] and [[Betuzalel (Between Angels and Demons)|Betuzalel]].

When God commanded her children to kneel before the man, she was confused, but she obeyed, and she was shocked at Lucifer's disobedience. During the Rebellion, she was forced to fight against her brothers and kill them, something that would leave a deep mark on her. Millennia after Lucier's arrest, Cassiel ventured into the realm of man, and came to love her Father's creation. She soon became attached to humanity, seeing its potential and the wonders of what they are capable of.

Formed by God Himself from the primordial void before the universe took shape, Nick is a higher being with a divine purpose. Unlike the angels, whose roles are often specific, Nick was made as a direct reflection of God’s will, yet without a clear mission beyond simply being. He stands as a witness to creation and a bridge between the finite world of humans and the infinite nature of the divine. Nick's defining trait is that he alone has seen the true face of God, understanding the vastness of the Creator's purpose in ways that no other being—angelic or human—could ever grasp. Despite his celestial origin, Nick looks human. His appearance is entirely adaptable, allowing him to blend seamlessly into any human culture and time period. He speaks all languages fluently, comprehends every religion with perfect insight, and knows the deep, hidden truths of Heaven, Hell, Limbo, Purgatory, and the entire multiverse. His knowledge of demons, archangels, Jesus Christ, and the mechanisms of the afterlife is unmatched. Since the dawn of Earth, Nick has been openly walking among humanity, guiding them, protecting them, and in many cases, influencing key events throughout history. Unlike many beings of immense power, he interacts with humans directly, offering them advice, solving problems, and combating forces of evil when necessary. Light''': Like any angel, Raphael could generate powerful white light and emanate it from his vessel. He could use it as a powerful burst of light manifesting as a kinetic force, throwing or repelling objects and beings at a considerable distance.
Granting''': Raphael was able to granting to Crowley immunity from Castiel's killing touch.

Control''': As a pure blood werewolf, Claire can fully control her transformation, plus she can manifest her fangs and claws even while maintaining a human appearance. *'''Immortality''': As other pure blood werewolves, Claire's aging process ceased the moment she was turned.
Strength''': After being transformed, Claire started to have a high level of physical strength, being able to fight against individuals much bigger than her and against monsters. After being enhanced by the [[Dread Doctors (Between Angels and Demons)|Dread Doctors]] experiments, Claire's strength has been increased to the point where she can face Goldschmidt, a vampire nearly 1000 years old.
Speed''': As a werewolf, Claire can run faster than the best Olympic athletes. After being enhanced, her speed became even higher, being able to reach, in her human form, young transformed werewolves.
Invulnerability'''
Healing/Regeneration''': As a werewolf, Claire can heal any non-lethal wounds quickly. After being honed by Doctors of Dread, her abilities became even stronger, being able to heal cuts almost instantly, as well as having regenerated an entire hand after being amputated in less than a day. *'''Immunity''': After becoming grace-enhanced, Claire gained further enhanced werewolf abilities, as well as being granted an immunity to silver.
Fangs''': Werewolves have powerful claws and are able to cut through solid walls. Their fangs can tear human flesh and can rip out a human heart right out of their chest

In terms of height, she was shorter than Dean and the same height as God's human form.

**Real magic takes time to fully manifest. Once a spell is cast, it requires time to marinate and gestate before it takes full effect. The time needed can decrease with the caster’s skill and power. This encourages patience and skill development among practitioners.
**Once a spell is cast, it cannot be changed. A spell, once initiated, remains fixed. If the caster dies or loses their magic, the spell becomes nearly irreversible, eventually fading away if it loses its energy source.
**Powerful spells can only be undone by the caster or practitioners of equal power. High-energy spells require equal or greater skill and power to be undone, making them particularly challenging to reverse once established.
*Undone spells return to raw magical essence. When spells are unraveled, the magic does not vanish; instead, it transforms back into raw magical essence, which can be harnessed by practitioners. This raw essence is volatile and requires skill to control.

Mara asks, “Charlie Kirk?” He answers plainly: '''No.''' Then he kneads the reasons like a craftsman shaping wire. “Kirk,” he says, “did not invent grievance — but he polished it and sold it.” He traces the causal chain: public personalities who specialize in moral panics and identity-conflict convert political anxieties into clear, efficient policy pressure. When the public conversation is shaped into “us vs them,” administrative responses become punitive, not reparative. He gives the example (not of a single quote but of an effect): campus programs defunded, students afraid to speak, local officials passing zero-tolerance policies that criminalize youthful protest — policy cascades that cost real children access to services and due process. He admits nuance — “a person’s right to speak is real” — but says influence has consequences beyond microfame: it shapes policing priorities, school budgets, and administrative enforcement. For that reason he would not support or vote for Kirk. (Background: profiles of Kirk show his role as a mass-reach conservative organizer and cultural provocateur.)

===Life Force===
*The Life Force, also known as Vital Energy, Spiritus Vitae, or Anima, is a mystical energy that permeates every single living being, it's the force that animates the body and allows biological processes to take place.
According to [[Life (The End of Time)|Life]] herself, without the Life Force, life is impossible.
*The Life Force plays a direct role in the lifespan of the individual. Each times a biological process is performed, it consumes part of the Life Force, and this consumption is countered by the Life Force producing more of itself.
*Ageing occurs when the Life Force's consumption out speeds the production, which results in lesser amounts of vital energy available for the body to grow and maintain itself, forcing it to discard or slow many of its process to save energy.
**This explains why younger individuals, such as babies and children, have stronger Life Force than adult and elderly individuals.
*If the Life Force is magically drained faster than it is able to be produced, the body will suffer, as all systems are running out of energy, causing them to weaken or even shut down completely. According to [[Castiel (The End of Time)|Castiel]], there is a specific threshold of which Life Force can naturally recharge itself after being drained, and if it is drained beyond this threshold, it will not be able to recharge in time and it will most certainly result in the death of the individual.

When Sam and Dean found [[Orville Thomas]] and learned that he was looking for Ian Patterson, Sam suggested that they try appealing to Judice as he had contacted her to help them with Ian before. Yet, fearing that an opportunity to get Orville's help to remove the [[Mark of Cain]] from Dean would be lost, Sam quietly went and called Judice for her help. Judice had been with Victor, [[Phillip Dawson|Phillip]], [[Riley Ackerman|Riley]] and a handful of other members of the Battalion, having a small party when her phone rang. She tensed a bit seeing that it was Sam that was calling and Victor quickly noticed and asked if she was okay. She said that she was fine and claimed it was simply her sister. Judice went off to talk to Sam and he told her that he was looking for Ian Patterson. Judice claimed that they were too as he had evaded them when they tried to bring him in weeks earlier when he called. He asked if she could dig around and find any information relating to him to give to him so that he and Dean could track him down but she said she couldn't just go and hand information like that, especially to him. The legal reality is ugly. Bureaucrats and lawyers zero in on collateral damage. When Nickolas pulls an entire wall off of a factory to pry open a shipping container full of trafficked laborers, insurers sue, citing the disruption of a supply chain and wage loss; municipal leaders demand repairs; national leaders demand to know whether his actions precipitated broader economic losses. That is the everyday bleed of extra-ordinary rescue: state machinery metabolizes the spectacle into paperwork, law suits, and audits. This is why real militaries and the Pentagon pay attention; they do not want to be forced into expensive, politically fraught rescue operations because a single actor created an expectation the state cannot consistently meet. === Primordial Magic ===
'''Primordial Magic''' represents the ultimate, all-encompassing source of magical power, embodying every magic system in existence. It is the origin of all other forms of magic, directly created by the primordial entity Khaos, with its practitioners able to access and wield a limitless variety of abilities. Each of the distinct magic systems—whether it be sorcery, dark magic, necromancy, or divination—derives its essence from Primordial Magic, making it the most powerful and versatile form of magic.

When activated, Primordial Magic manifests as a yellow energy with darker yellow and black hues, symbolizing its connection to the fundamental forces of existence.

Practitioners of Primordial Magic can access any form of magic, drawing upon powers ranging from energy manipulation and reality warping to divine and demonic forces. They hold the knowledge of all magical practices, making them versatile and immensely powerful. However, with such vast potential comes the challenge of control, as mastering this primordial source requires understanding the delicate balance between the various magical systems.

In essence, Primordial Magic is the foundation from which all other magic systems flow, a limitless and primal force that enables the wielder to access any form of magic known, all while manifesting through a shifting, radiant mist that reflects the diversity of the powers it controls.

'''Key
the Order of Letters'''
It was described as the key to "every object, scroll, spell ever collected for thousands of years under one roof", as well as being the "supernatural mother lode". ==Characteristics== The key is kept inside a small box with the {{Spn|Aquarian Star}} inscribed on it. It was small enough to be carried by Men of Letters and to be concealed from sight. According to [[Nate Singer (SJTV)|Nate Singer]], it not only opens the {{Spn|Men of Letters bunker}}, but every Men of Letters chapter house in the {{Spn|Earth|world}}. ==History== On August 12, 1958, the key was held by {{Spn|Larry Ganem}}, who passed it on to {{Spn|Henry Winchester}} for protection from the {{Spn|demon}} {{Spn|Abaddon}}. Henry Winchester traveled to the future with the intention of meeting his blood relative and son, [[John Winchester]] but ended up in [[Sam Winchester|Sam]] and [[Dean Winchester|Dean]]'s motel room in 2013. In 2004, [[Nate Singer (SJTV)|Nate Singer]] created and used another copy of the key to get inside the {{Spn|Men of Letters bunker}}. He later used it again to get inside the [[Men of Letters South Dakota Chapter House (SJTV)|South Dakota Chapter House]] that he created. Unfortunately, Abaddon managed to follow Henry to 2013. The Winchesters attempted to keep the demon from acquiring the key.

was a troubled kid always getting into fights and running away. When he was 16 he accidentally burned down his high school's gymnasium and went on the run from the police. The Battalion received word that three of their scouts had been found murdered, all within the same general area of Ohio within the same week. Victor leads an investigation along with Riley and [[Judice Parker]] as they take two other battalion members to learn what happened to the scouts. Judice does some checking and finds out that the three of them didn't seem to have connections or could know one another, and as mere scouts they wouldn't know about other Battalion scouts in the area per their rules to protect them from their enemies. Riley notes that this can't be a coincidence and wonders if the scouts had been separately looking into the same thing which got them all killed. At the morgue, they found that there is no evidence of demonic or angelic involvement as two of them were shot while the third had been poisoned. They decide to split up and check all three of the scout's homes and Riley manages to find that his scout victim left a crime board that suggests that a local startup company had been a stone throw away from bankruptcy but had suddenly become a rising star with its owner well on his way to becoming a one percenter. It seems that the others had found odd cases, one with a deathly dying little girl now fully healed like nothing had happened and three local teen boys who were on the same football team had all suffered separate fatal accidents within the same day. Riley, along with Victor and Judice, realize that these had the markings of crossroad deals.

==Biography==

===Background===
Death came to be when the first life was created, emerging from the [[Primal Chaos (The End of Time)|Primal Chaos]], uniting the concepts of death, end and departure in a coherent way and organizing its behavior into a conscious mind, alongside its twin sister [[Life (The End of Time)|Life]], and they were tied by the [[The Natural Order (The End of Time)#Cosmic Entanglement|Cosmic Entanglement]]. When [[God (The End of Time)|God]] and [[Asherah (The End of Time)|Asherah]] went into war with the [[Primordial Entities (The End of Time)|primordials]] that didn't agreed with creation. Death's exact role in this war is largely unknown, but he was probably at God's side, that would explain why God didn't locked him away after the war.

Death claimed he was around when God created the first beasts, the [[Leviathans (The End of Time)|Leviathans]], and even, as he said, "''personally found them entertaining.''". When [[Adam (The End of Time)|Adam]] and [[Eve (The End of Time)|Eve]] fell from the [[Eden (The End of Time)|Garden]], Death, alongside the other Horsemen, they 'rode' across the Earth, spreading their influence and power over humanity. At a unknown point, Death took the [[Archangels (The End of Time)|archangel]] [[Azrael (The End of Time)|Azrael]] as his apprentice.

*'''Invunerability''': Samael is next to indestructible and cannot be killed by any conventional weapon. Even Holy Fire was only able to banish him for a short time. Only God, Death, and an archangel blade are capable of killing Samael.

She explained that the Coven was now facing extinction due to all the demon attacks and from a Druid from the Thomas family that had recently became active. This form of magic is invaluable for navigating complex social interactions, influencing individuals or groups, and uncovering hidden truths that lie beneath surface appearances. === Searching for Dean and Protecting Kevin ===
Following Dean and Castiel's disappearance into Purgatory, CJ spent nearly a year desperately searching for any sign of them alongside her sister, Freya. Despite exhausting every lead, the sisters were unable to determine Dean's and Castiel's whereabouts. At the same time, Kevin Tran and Meg Masters had also vanished, leaving them with no reliable clues to pursue. Eventually, Sam informed CJ and Freya that he was leaving. Although heartbroken, CJ understood that she could not force him to stay. Before he departed, she asked him to keep his phone on in case she ever needed his help. Unbeknownst to her, Sam later discarded his old phones, making it impossible for her to contact him despite her repeated attempts. With the assistance of Charlie, CJ and Freya successfully rescued Kevin from Crowley's forces. Knowing he remained a target for demons, they hid him aboard Garth's houseboat, believing it to be the safest place available. During this time, CJ took on a maternal role toward Kevin, ensuring he was well-fed, cared for, and protected while continuing the search for Dean and Castiel.

Only a few days after Kevin's rescue, CJ discovered that she was pregnant with her and Dean's third child. Already raising Mary and Wyatt, she struggled to balance motherhood with protecting Kevin, searching for her missing husband, and worrying about Sam's unexplained disappearance. Rayne possesses a wide variety of psychic abilities.
Due to having lived for 500 years, Rayne possesses a wide range of knowledge of the supernatural world.
Being a Dhampir, Rayne has extremely keen senses of hearing, sight, smell, and taste that are heightened to levels beyond to those possessed by true vampires. She can hear whispered conversations (even ones in far of buildings and on phones) and can tune out most ambient noises when it's not necessary to hear them. ===[[Deities (The End of Time)|Deities]]===
Deity souls, formally called Divinity, are the spiritual essence of [[Deities (The End of Time)|deities]], being the source of their abilities, and manifest as a luminescent sphere with blue hues. The souls of deities vary in intensity, which determines their level of power, and their owners can determine whether their offspring will have a soul of the same intensity or lower, it can never be higher, as well as how dependent they are on belief and worship, and can even determine whether their offspring will inherit Divinity or not, defining whether they will be gods like their parents or not. If a deity is killed, they enter a comatose state and eventually return to life, and the length of this regeneration process depends on how much they are believed in and worshipped. Deities can only be truly killed if there are no longer any believers or worshippers, at which point their souls go to [[The Empty (The End of Time)|the Empty]].

===[[Demigods (TOWT)|Demigods]] Existence===
Demigods lives are ruled by Law of Unique Essence and Law of Main Avatars.

Demigods are created from the union of a [[Gods (TOWT)|God]] with a non-divine being (usually humans), and during their life, their God-half grants them access to [[Magic (TOWT)#Divine Magic|Divine Magic]], but their mortal half limits their access. Thus, Demigods begin their lives with power equal to regular [[Sinners (TOWT)|Sinners]] and [[Winners (TOWT)|Winners]], and upon reaching maturity, their power is equivalent to the [[Heavenly Virtues (TOWT)|Heavenly Virtues]] and [[Deadly Sins (TOWT)|Deadly Sins]]. However, despite this, the soul of a Demigod is still the soul of a God, but trapped and limited by a mortal body, so, upon death, this mortal half is purged and the Demigod ascends and becomes a full God.

Despite being most time in [[Hell (TOWT)|Hell]], Ayin was aware of all the things that happened throughout Creation.

<big>'''[[Alastor – Born on November 1st, Between Saints and Shadows]]'''</big>

Alastor, known as the “Radio Demon,” is a figure shrouded in mystery, cruelty, and charm. His birthdate, November 1st, is more than just a detail — it is a vital piece of symbolic construction. This date marks All Saints’ Day, a religious celebration honoring all saints and martyrs, known and unknown. The irony is striking: a sadistic and fearsome being born on a day devoted to purity and virtue.

But there are deeper layers. The name "Alastor" comes from ancient Greek, meaning “spirit of vengeance” — an unforgiving entity tied to violent retribution, moral judgment, and punishment. In ancient mythology, it was a title associated with deities who punished crimes of pride and blood — a perfect reflection of Alastor’s persona: a macabre enforcer cloaked in elegance, smiling as he brings chaos.

November, the month of his birth, also holds powerful symbolism. Associated with autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, it is a time when nature dies to be reborn — marked by falling leaves, darker days, and a somber, introspective air. It is often considered the month of the dead, a time of remembrance, silence, and spiritual depth — an ideal backdrop for the birth of someone like Alastor, who walks the line between life and death, charm and horror.

===== Cainite Corporation =====
Founded in 688 AD, the Cainite Corporation is a multi-organization that is run entirely by vampires. It was founded by Nubia, the first Vampire created by Cain, and is in fact owned by Cain himself. The Corporation manufactures and exports of Vampire-made products to areas and customers throughout Hell. These products are usually inspired by Earth-made inventions or innovative ideas ranging from clothing, vehicles, machinery, pharmaceuticals, energy, furniture, weapons, electronics, materials, and so forth. Most products are sold to Hellborns, including Royals and Nobles, (with weapons primarily sold to the former), along with other high-ranked individuals, but the Corporation also sells to Sinners too. The Cainite Corporation has also begun the manufacturing synthetic plasma, leading to the cloning of blood, which the Vampires can use in substitution of drinking the blood of cattle and demons. Additionally, the company does its own storage and delivery system, meaning they are not reliant on others in protecting and transporting their goods. It has also taken many other businesses under their wing as subsidiaries. Stores that sell their goods tend to get an increase in profits, and security as the vampires will protect these places to ensure no theft of their products happens. Nubia is a curvy woman appearing in her twenties. She stands around seven feet, and like all vampires she has pale skin and red eyes, which went well with her wavy, platinum silver hair going down towards her waist, with a few bangs covering her ears, plus black lipstick and black fingernails. Nubia can project purplish energy attacks, usually from her hands or even her eyes to hit, destroy, or blow away her targets, potentially exerting enough force to destroy other entities or structures altogether. When she began her rise as an Archfiend, Nubia's energy projections were powerful enough to wound Ars Goetia and Overlords. She mostly fires them as balls of energy, able to have them hover around her before Nubia fires them off one at a time. While projecting them from her eyes as energy beams with enough concussive force to knock back a person as big as Zeezi or cut through lesser demons with ease.
Uniquely, the energy Nubia generates can be used to enhance her physical prowess. This includes increasing her strength, speed, reflexes, and even durability. With this, Nubia was able to overpower several demons and would-be slayers in the past with nothing but brute force.

Charlie is Lucifer's daughter, who he is very protective of. In the pilot, it is implied that Lucifer does not believe in his daughter's plan to rehabilitate Sinners. When Charlie calls Lilith to talk about her failed interview, she says "I think Dad was right about me". Nonetheless, Charlie did take his words of dealing with demons to heart, such as Alastor.

In "Dad Beat Dad", Charlie reveals her parents separated, and she hardly sees her father anymore. She only hears from him when he needs something or when he is bored. Despite Lucifer being willing to use his influence for his daughter's needs, she is hesitant to overuse that privilege. She only used it when she needed to visit Heaven's higher-ups, which tested the limits of her father's power. When, for the first time in years, Charlie initiated a phone call between them, Lucifer was shocked and excited when he saw his daughter calling, wanting it to be perfect. It is evident he still deeply loved her due to all his family photos, and the two share many mannerisms. He tries to come off as cool, but he awkwardly plays down how distant they've become in the present day, not remembering about Charlie's Hazbin Hotel, despite the fact she had told him about it previously. '''Vincent Whittman''', preferred to be known as '''Vox''', is one of the bigger antagonists in ''Hazbin Hotel'', being a major antagonist in season 1, and the main antagonist of season 2.

He is a sinner demon and one of the many powerful Overlords of Hell. Vox is the founder, former co-owner of the Entertainment District, and on cease of owning his company, VoxTek Enterprises, along with being the de facto leader and former public face of the Overlord trio known as the Vees, alongside Valentino and Velvette.

A technology-savvy businessman, Vox once pulled the strings of Hell's news and entertainment media. He was determined to keep his iron grip over Pentagram City's citizens from the Radio Demon, Alastor, his nemesis in terms of influence and technology.

The Hunter is a master alchemist, having crafted numerous magical items over the years to aid him in his mission. Most notable is the power suit and coat he wears, both of which gives him an advantage in most situations. He can also transmute matter via physical contact, turning stone into sand or causing the air to combust.

Sir Pentious reveals in “Storyteller” that he was always a loner, and would watch people from afar. This was also proven to be true when Husk reveals that he watches people sleep. Showing that below the villain's essence, he shows, he’s only wanted friends and someone to be with.


On his final moments in Hell, Sir Pentious took the rash decision to risk his life for his friends, going against Adam with his airship and his egg Boiz. Finally changing for the good and became better.

==Past==
Charlie was born in [[Hell]] to [[Lucifer Morningstar]] and [[Lilith]], the rulers of the realm.<ref>"[[Overture]]"</ref>

During junior high school, Charlie went through an "emo phase".

At some point in her early life, Charlie would become acquainted with the von Eldritch family due to her family's connections in Hell. Charlie and Hellsa would eventually become bitter rivals. Charlie was also in a relationship with Hellsa's brother Seviathan at some point, but for unknown reasons they broke things off.

Five years prior to Liliths disappearance, Charlie was slowly worshipping her idea of rehabilitating sinners and started with an online website called “Help2u” which would host live videos for souls to watch on how to be a better person, and she would post small tutorials on how to be better. But after low views and embarrassing moments, she decided to sell her website to Belphegir who transformed her website into an online drug store.

Three years prior to "Hello Rosie!", Charlie discovered the heavily injured Vaggie in an alleyway in the aftermath of the fourth Extermination. Charlie bandaged Vaggie's missing eye and the two became friends; this would eventually lead to a romantic relationship forming between them.

Sometime before the pilot, Charlie decided to open up the Happy Hotel in order to rehabilitate sinners and send them to Heaven as an alternative method toward the overpopulation crisis.

Satan is a towering demon, standing slightly taller than his fellow Sins, being a foot taller than Mammon and Asmodeus. His appearance is like that of Imps, having their red colored skin, except he has a dragon-like face, with four black horns on the top of his head and four yellow eyes. Sticking from his back are a pair of large red wings, along with a long red tail that ends with a barbed arrow-tipped point.

For clothing, Satan normally wears what appears to be a cross between a stereotypical cowboy and biker. This includes a tattered black hat with a golden star on it, with his horns sticking out of, plus brown leather boots. Followed by worn torn black jeans, a brown shirt and black vest, with a red bandana around his neck and a black leather coat. His pants are held by a black belt with a golden plate as the buckle, and a golden Sheriff star on the left side of his coat. Finally, Satan wears black fingerless gloves over his hands.

Angel Dust is the former fellow hotel guest and good friend of Sir Pentious. Initially, Angel helps Cherri Bomb fight Sir Pentious in the turf war, in which he constantly mocks him with various sex jokes. Sir Pentious mistakes him for his son after misunderstanding Angel's attempt to call him "Daddy". Sir Pentious sought revenge against Angel at the Happy Hotel before being defeated by Alastor.

In "Radio Killed the Video Star", Angel continues to mock and distrust Sir Pentious as he attempts to redeem himself at the hotel, feeling bad about Charlie's appreciation of Pentious, before discovering his alliance with Vox. In response to Angel's insults, Sir Pentious treats him with hostility, calling him a "whore." After agreeing to fully redeem himself, Sir Pentious agreed to live in the hotel, participating in a trust exercise, in which he begins to befriend Angel after surviving a turf battle. 

Despite their friendship, Sir Pentious gets into an argument over Angel's sex advances. Sir Pentious was cheerful when he spent time with Angel, Husk, Niffty, and Cherri at the bar, faithfully acknowledging them as his friends. == Frenemies ==
'''Alastor''': Rose sometimes says really dumb puns, much like Angel Dust harassing Husk, but she makes herself become really stupid and idiotic. Rose is like Angel, but twice the more dumber than him with Alastor. And Alastor really hates Rose, to the point he's more or less likely gonna kill her if she continues.

Alastor did at one point scare the living be-jesus out of Rose, just for one question. I mean, if you were in Rose's shoes at that encounter; you'd also feel deeply scared and intimidated by Alastor becoming the spooky version of him but slower.

Alastor and Rose have patched up their friendship a little bit, by having Rose tell Alastor what she is in truthful words. Which Rose had Alastor promise to never tell anyone about their secret, little do they know that Angel Dust listened in and was also gonna keep Rose's secret a secret as well.

== Enemies ==
'''The Three Vees''': Rose didn't know about the Vees, but she did teleport the hotel's bugs into the Three Vee Tower without knowing about it. She didn't know if the bugs were still there, but she indirectly made them have an exterminator come over to kill the bugs or something.

'''Valentino''': Rose usually is asked, by Charlie, to go and pick up Angel Dust after his usual work shifts are over now that Rose is someone to the hotel's use. And Rose, thrice in a row, heads butts with Valentino sometimes. In the latest pick up for Angel Dust, Rose and Valentino got into a brutual fight in the porn

**'''Sealing & Binding''': Cain can restrain people at will, usually as a form of punishment. (i might come back to this later baii) === Story === ===== Human Life ===== Ari was born and raised in San Francisco, and she had a good childhood, even though she got bullied. Her sister was a famous actor, and she wanted to follow in her footsteps. She kept on trying to land a role somewhere, and eventually got cast as a background character in a small movie. ===Angelic Steel===
'''Angelic Steel''' is a metal infused with Angelic Magic. It is considered a sacred and divine metal, its profane and demonic counterpart is Demonic Steel. Like earthly steel, Angelic Steel is an alloy made of celestial iron and carbon.

Angelic Steel is extremely strong and virtually indestructible by conventional means, and as such, it is used in the creation of weapons, and can be used to harm and kill all species of [[Angels (TOWT)|Angel]] and all species of [[Demons (TOWT)|Demon]] with the exception of the [[Deadly Sins (TOWT)|Deadly Sins]] and [[Elder Demons (TOWT)|Elder Demons]]. Angelic Steel can only be safely handled by Angels and descendants of Angels. Demons who attempt to use it will be burned, and Humans who attempt to use it will also be afflicted with great pain, unless they are virtuous souls, that is, destined for Heaven after death. Demons and non-virtuous humans can only safely wield Angelic Steel if the item receives a special blessing that only Angels and Gods can give.

Angelic Steel's arcane power is such that one single stab is enough to damage not only the physical form but also the soul of the target, so those who wield it need to be careful with how intense and strong they use the weapon. '''Divine Steel''' is a metal infused with Divine Magic. It is considered sacred and divine metal, the most powerful of all and the only one able to harm the [[Gods (TOWT)|Gods]].

Divine Steel is extremely strong and virtually indestructible by conventional means, and as such, it is used in the creation of weapons, and can be used to harm and kill all species of [[Angels (TOWT)|Angel]] and all species of [[Demons (TOWT)|Demon]]. Divine Steel can only be safely handled by Gods, Demigods, Avatars, descendants of the Gods or someone blessed by them. Those who attempt to use it that does not belong to any of the former categories will be burned and incinerated to death.

Divine Steel has an immense, almost limitless arcane power, vastly superior than even the highest-quality Angelic and Demonic Steels, where a single stab could cause immediate and total Scattering of the target's soul. Also, Divine Steel can host fragments of a God's power, allowing its wielder to "borrow" the power within, although it is finite and non self-rechargeable.

Divine Steel only occurs and is found naturally in [[Realms (TOWT)#Far Shore|Far Shore]], which is also the only place where it can be forged and manipulated safely, and if forged in another realm, it will not be as effective.

{{Quote|You can take a hit, nice going old bag|Husk welcoming Sir Pentious}}
Sir Pentious considered Husk an enemy during his attacks on the hotel. After settling down and seeking redemption, Sir Pentious showed distrust of his other roommates, including Husk, so Vaggie led a trust exercise to get everyone involved in a turf battle. After the battle, Sir Pentious earned Husk's respect when he managed to stay on his feet during a battle against a demon and the two began to become friends. However, Husk recognized Sir Pentious' personality, seeing him as an "insecure buffoon" who spies on everyone while they sleep.

Despite the prejudices, Sir Pentious formed a close friendship with Husk, who considered him a good drinking buddy with Angel Dust and Niffty. After his sacrifice and supposed death at the hands of Adam, Husk was among those that honor his sacrifice at his memorial after the hotel's reconstruction. In "Storyteller", in his room in Heaven, Sir Pentious nostalgically touched the painting with the faces of his friends, which included Husk.

* '''Musical Wings -''' Midnight is capable of manifesting enormous, glowing wings composed of flowing musical staves, luminous notes, and harmonic energy. These wings function both as tools of flight and as powerful defensive constructs, allowing her to glide, hover, and maneuver through the air with exceptional speed and control. When fully extended, the wings can also act as durable shields, blocking attacks and absorbing impact through pulsing resonance. When Midnight beats her wings with force, they generate powerful sonic shockwaves, releasing bursts of concentrated sound capable of knocking enemies back, shattering structures, or destabilizing opponents with overwhelming vibration. The wings can shift in shape and size depending on her emotional state, sometimes appearing graceful and angelic, other times sharp, jagged, and intensely radiant when she is enraged or distressed. Unlike traditional demonic wings, Midnight’s are strikingly theatrical and musical in nature, emphasizing her identity as the Music Demon and blending beauty with devastating power.

Классик мировой литературы. Почётный академик Императорской академии наук по разряду изящной словесности (1900—1902). Один из самых известных драматургов мира. Его произведения переведены более чем на сто языков. Его пьесы, в особенности «Чайка», «Три сестры» и «Вишнёвый сад», на протяжении более ста лет ставятся во многих театрах мира. '''Adam''' was a winner archangel and the main antagonist of the first season of ''Hazbin Hotel''. He made his official debut alongside his lieutenant, Lute, in "Overture".

He was the first human man created and the first human soul to enter Heaven. After becoming an angel, he became the commander of the angelic military force known as Exorcists, and served Heaven as forerunner of the Extermination movement.

In "The Show Must Go On", he was defeated by Lucifer Morningstar and killed by Niffty. After his death, his position as head of the Exorcists was passed down to his son, Abel.

==Appearance==
Adam was an angel with a human appearance. Most of the time, he wore a mask that appeared similar to fellow Exorcists, though with normal-looking eyes and golden facial expressions. The mask also held a pair of horns similar to an Exorcist, albeit longer, smoother, and with a golden ornamental attachment on the tips.

Under his mask, he is revealed to be a fair-skinned angel with golden-yellow eyes that have dark bags underneath, a stubble-beard on his chin, and slightly messy, short cedar-brown colored hair.

He also had a pair of large and golden wings on his back. In contrast to other angels that have appeared thus far, Adam's halo was bright gold in appearance, and similar to the Exorcists, has two spikes pointing up and down from each ot

However, the angel himself disliked this name and eventually abandoned it, choosing a new one, which humans themselves later chose for him. How and when he was born is unknown. He was God's most beloved son, for God believed that this archangel, unlike the others, would be able to bring benefit not only to Paradise but also to Earth for all of humanity. They taught him protection, self-defense, and the concept of good and evil. Furthermore, Archangel Gabriel foresaw Vaniel's future and learned that he would one day become a demon hunter and bring peace between Heaven and Hell. However, he hid this from everyone and even erased his own memory. The only thing he revealed about the future was that people would name Vaniel Van Helsing. The size of these summons range heavily, from those who stand up to Nicabar's knee, to regular size creatures and finally those who tower over even buildings. Some of these creatures even possess special abilities that make them even more dangerous, especially when fighting alongside Nicabar or be used for communication and spying. He doesn't even need to bring them out fully, as just manifesting parts of them like limbs or tentacles through portals is more than enough to overwhelm his enemies, as he did during his rise against several Overlords where he summoned two pairs of large hands to launch powerful beams of magic to wipe out a group of Overlords at once. Otherwise, he will also materialize items that he needs, such as weapons which usually consists of spears, or furniture for any guests he might have as he did with Vox. One time, Nicabar summoned a shower of meteors from a large portal in the sky, wiping out a town in Pride Ring.

added_text: **'''[[Scattering (TOWT)|Scattering]]''': One of the few known ways to truly defeat an immortal. As dictated by the [[The Natural Order (TOWT)#Law of Unique Essence|Law of Unique Essence]], if someone's soul is divided, it will be weakened proportionately and become unstable. Despite the instability caused by the fragmentation, souls can still remain unified to a certain extent. If the soul is damaged enough, the instability generated will be so intense that the fragments will no longer be able to remain united and will separate, triggering a process known as scattering. The process of scattering is where the being in question destroys their physical form and scatters their essence to such an extent that it is believed that they won't ever be able to form a consciousness again, let alone a body. Thus they are scattered and harmless, though they aren't dead. If they are already weakened, the process is much easier. If a being dies from having their soul fragmented and damaged in the Scattering, the soul fragments will eventually merge into a new entity and begin the Rebirth Cycle again. Furthermore, the more powerful the being is, the greater their chance of retaining memories and abilities from their past incarnations, and this new being would rather be a "new aspect" of the previous one instead of a new entity.

Chris was a well-kept and formally mannered individual, the kind of person who always made sure his clothes were tidy, his posture upright, and his words chosen with care. He had a kind and gentle soul, one that leaned more into empathy and soft-spoken charm than loud presence. His kindness wasn’t showy—it was the quiet sort that made people feel heard and safe, even in their lowest moments. He wasn’t quick to anger and rarely raised his voice, instead relying on calm reasoning and emotional intelligence to navigate tension. Chris carried himself like someone from an older era, admiring the grace and romance of the past, often humming to classic tunes from Lesley Gore or Little Peggy March while going about his day. He adored love songs, sentimental gestures, and old-fashioned romance, and while he wasn’t one to overshare, his affections ran deep and loyal. Underneath it all, there was a longing for connection and a quiet ache he never let others see—choosing to comfort others rather than burden them with his own troubles.

Samyaza was once one of the most impressive angels in heaven: she had an ethereal and androgynous appearance, porcelain skin with expansive twin wings extending from her back, while her platinum hair and sclerotid glowed with a heavenly brilliance. His eyes were adorned with white pupils and halo-shaped irises. A halo of two rings floated just above his head. Adorned in an outfit befitting his celestial status, Samyaza wore a white ruff enhanced with silver trim, matching epaulettes, and fingerless gauntlets. His ensemble was completed with a long-sleeved white minidress and metallic boots with silver trim and protective shin guards, evoking an aura of heavenly majesty. After falling and spending forty generations in Hell, Samyaza's appearance changed radically: he became thin and emaciated, his skin became black and cold as ice, his eyes became azure blue, small celestial flames escaped from them, and he spoke haltingly again. He now dresses in black and gray rags, covering his head with a hood, and covering his face with a black wool scarf, the rest of his clothing is boiled leather garments and a chain mail shirt.

The runes are usually activated if someone passes by them or touches the spot where they are, otherwise the Hunter can activate them remotely. The strength of these barriers is influenced by her emotional state and vocal intensity; stronger focus or powerful singing amplifies their durability. Unlike traditional demonic shields, Midnight’s defenses feel like a protective concert hall made manifest — elegant, radiant, and fortified by pure musical force.

==Appearance==
Adrian Castillo is a human male from New York City, New York. He has dark brown eyes, short black hair, and a clean, practical hairstyle that he keeps neat due to his work with the U.S. Marshals Service. He has a fit build from training and field work. When on duty, Adrian usually wears tactical U.S. Marshals Service gear, including a dark ballistic vest marked with “U.S. Marshal,” a long-sleeved shirt or tactical uniform, duty pants, gloves, boots, and a badge displayed where it can be clearly seen. He may also carry standard law enforcement equipment used for fugitive apprehension, such as handcuffs, a radio, a sidearm/rifle, and other field gear depending on the operation.
Off duty, Adrian dresses casually and comfortably, usually wearing hoodies, jackets, jeans, sneakers, or simple streetwear common around New York City. When he has time away from work, he enjoys going to motorsport shows and air races, especially when visiting family around the Bronx and Harlem.

Before his death,
As a demon, Chris is unhinged, unfiltered, and completely driven by emotional extremes. All that elegance and kindness he had in life? Still buried in there somewhere, but now it’s distorted, corrupted, and warped into obsession and vengeance. He swears like it’s a second language, throwing out strings of curses so intense that even the censors can’t keep up. He’s violent, erratic, and brutally expressive—especially when someone disrespects something he cares about. You say you don’t like his favorite song? You’re getting slammed into a wall. You insult Lesley Gore? Expect a full-force kick to the ribs. He acts out of raw, instinctive passion now, guided more by emotion than reason. He’s still loyal, still devoted—but in a possessive, terrifying way. There's a glint of his past self in his movements, like when he dances to old tunes with eerie precision, swaying to the melody while his eyes burn like fire. Underneath the rage and fury is a heart that was once so full of love, now shattered and twisted into something monstrous. But he remembers what he was. And sometimes, when no one's looking, he hums “I Will Follow Him” softly to himself, as if trying to find the pieces again.

After some time, Abadai learned that Prince [https://hazbinhotel.fandom.com/wiki/Stolas Stolas] lived in this ring of Hell, possessing a magical book called a grimoire. With its help, assassins from I.M.P. headquarters traveled from Hell to the human world on Earth. Upon learning of this, Abadai decided to obtain the book and use it to return home to Earth and escape Hell. Fortunately, upon entering Hell, he had the ability to change his voice and shapeshift. He began transforming into the local demons and carefully studied their appearances. Closely observing [https://hazbinhotel.fandom.com/wiki/Blitzo Blitzo], he decided to adopt his form and, through him, try to obtain the grimoire. When the real Blitzo left on business, leaving I.M.P., Abadai changed his dark chameleon form to Blitzo and, in his guise, began trying to obtain the grimoire so that he could use it to return home to Earth. Stolas, strangely enough, out of his love and naivety, believed the false Blitzo and handed him the grimoire. The false Blitzo tried to ask [https://hazbinhotel.fandom.com/wiki/Loona Loona] to open a portal for him, as he couldn't read and didn't know how to open one. However, the hellhound, with her keen sense of smell, easily discerned that this was not the real Blitzo, but an impostor. She took the grimoire from the dark chameleon and threatened to kill him with a pistol if he didn't leave. Abadai was frightened and fled, but couldn't understand how she had caught him.

Beings who are absorbed are still alive, and can be released later at Cain's will. Those who are describe the sensation as one of terror.

This also includes controlling the skeletons, dead flesh, and corpses, as when Cain reanimated the recently killed Exorcists to attack their former comrades. Even further, Cain broke down and rearranged several sinner bodies to create large grotesque entities or even just giant limbs made of flesh and/or bones.

At first causing crops Cain tries to grow rot and die, now he can release entropy on anything or anyone he makes contact with. Thus his targets will age swiftly, going from causing the bones of whomever Cain touches to become brittle and break, to completely deteriorate, eventually disintegrating until nothing is left. Cain even caused an angelic spear to corrode and break apart upon grabbing it. Cain can even reduce a person's lifespan without causing any physical changes to occur.

== Appearance ==
In life, Velnef (Debbie) was a girl with crystal blue eyes and straight blonde hair, she was around 1.60 to 1.70 meters tall. In hell, Velnef has red hair, ash-colored skin and red eyes, she usually wears a black top, black nails, a black miniskirt and black sneakers

== Personality ==
As a human, she was very shy, and an easy target for the bullying she received at school. Her mother was a religious fanatic (similar to Carrie's mother) who constantly subjected her to extreme abuse, based on a fundamentalist religious fanaticism that demonizes sexuality and the female body, and locked her in a closet to pray, where there was a picture of Saint Lucy with her eyes gouged out, which created several psychological traumas when she screamed and asked her mother to take her out of the closet.

Once in hell, Velnef became cold, very distrustful, and was prepared to defend herself with her telekinesis if anyone made her feel bad or humiliated her. When she made friends at the hotel, she felt "loved" and was able to open up a little more to everyone.

== Senior Prom ==
Velnef doesn't plan on going to the prom, since she doesn't have a date and nothing to wear. A girl named Lisa tells the popular boy in class, Ethan, to go to the prom with Velnef. He agrees and asks her in the library. Velnef isn't sure about accepting, but she eventually agrees.  Sherry, the leader of the bully group, finds out and plans to play a very mean prank on Velnef with the help of her boyfrie

==History==
The second and current generation of Watchers was founded by Amenadiel, the Archangel of Time. 10,000 years ago he approached his God, Asherah and his siblings about recreating the Grigori. He theorized that the reason for the first iteration's fall was because they were Heavenborn Angels, and thus unprepared for human nature and Sin itself. What Amenadiel wanted to do was create an organization of Winners, humans who were once warriors, leaders, protectors, scholars, and healers, to not only watch over humanity, but also act as responders to supernatural threats.

Though intrigued, God wished to test these chosen former humans. Amenadiel selected several individuals, among them Mastema, a former member of the original Grigori who redeemed himself when he gave his life to protect Noah's Ark. Together, this small group pushed back Asmodeus and his followers when the Sin of Lust attempted to corrupt the City of Babylon. Despite their attempts to seduce them to Sin, the demons were unable to break the wills of the Winners and were eventually pushed back to Hell, with Amenadiel having injured Asmodeus.

Pleased with this, and proud of the Winners and their indomitable wills, God approved this new fighting force and both he and Asherah gave Amenadiel their blessing. And thus a new Grigori was born, called the Watcher Paladins, given the duty to protect humanity and Earth from any threats. Eskender would leave Albert's electrified corpse there and just dip when he saw Albert's hand move slightly. === Return to the Hotel and Peace (2033): === Albert then returned to the hotel when his limbs fully regenerated and he went back to hunting the crew down. == Appearance == Velvette is a slim and petite humanoid demoness with cedar-brown skin, and long curly hair kept into large pigtails with bangs by black hair ties. Her hair is colored in a desire-red that features the insides colored in a faded dark navy-blue, and white swirled-streaks on her pigtails and one on her bangs. Her eyes have white irises, bright red sclera and slit pupils, and her makeup consists of burgundy eyeshadow on her eyelids, and black lipstick on her lips with a strip across the center of her mouth, which has fangs inside. She has doll-like seams on several parts of her body such as her elbow and knee joints, along with her stomach and shoulders, among others. Velvette's clothing is that of a set of white skull earrings, and a sleeveless dark navy-blue coat with burgundy lining and two desire hearts on the left side of the fur collar (similar to the ones on Valentino's). Her coat is usually worn over a sleeveless, black turtleneck crop top that includes two desire hearts on the chest. Her loose pants are colored in navy-blue and desire-red in a striped pattern, held by a dark navy belt with a white heart-shaped buckle. For footwear, she wore black low-heeled flats with white pom-poms on top. Velvette accessorized with black-striped fingerless opera gloves with alternating colors - white for her right glove and desire for her left. Velvette changes hairstyles and outfits frequently.

Lucifer is Charlie's dad and it is implied that Lucifer initially does not believe in Charlie’s idea to rehabilitate sinners, shown when Charlie says, “I think Dad was right about me” while calling Lilith.

But despite this, both of them still continue to share different ideals for Sinners and Lucifer only starts to like the redemption plan after he realizes Charlie proved Heaven wrong.

===Demigod Generation===
Like humans and gods, demigods can also be grouped in different generations. A demigod generation starts when a god enters a period colloquially known as "fertility cycle", in which a god produces several demigod children within a small time range, usually with an interval of 4 months for minor gods and Demi-Olympians, 6 months for Demi-Titans and 1 year for Demi-Protogenoi, and each generation are composed of at least 12 demigods, though it can be less or more depending on the cycle.

A demigod generation only truly ends when the youngest child reaches their early 20s, the time they reach physical adulthood/maturity, and when their superhuman longevity activates and manifests.

# '''Tuesday Sundown Empowerment:''' Children of Samael become stronger from '''Tuesday sundown until midnight''', when the world naturally aligns with the forces of severity and judgement associated with Samael. During this time, their dark-aligned abilities become more potent and easier to control. Powers related to '''fear, judgement, death, temptation, shadows, and destructive force''' gain a temporary boost in strength and effectiveness.  Their intimidating presence also intensifies, making enemies more likely to feel uneasy, hesitant, or fearful when confronting them. Serpents, devils, corrupted spirits, and other dark-aligned beings may become more responsive to their authority during this period.  This boost is shared by many dark-aligned entities across the world due to Samael’s dominion over destructive forces and the corrupted aspect of judgement.  '''Limitations:'''  The empowerment only lasts from '''Tuesday sundown until midnight''', and its effects are '''greatly weakened within the Promised Land''', where Samael’s authority is limited.

==Western Civilization==
'''Western Civilization''' is a metaphysical force which moves with the flow of civilization. It is the pure essence of mankind's culture and connects together everything that constitutes humanity's collective spirit and civilization, according to [[Chiron (The One Who Theorizes)|Chiron]]. Occasionally referred to as the "flame" by gods, demigods, and monsters, this force moves with the center of human prosperity and influence, and was originally founded in Greece. From there, it was carried by Zephyros, the Western wind, to Rome, and then traveled across Europe, stopping in Germany, France, Spain, and eventually ending up in Great Britain for a while. The current center of the "flame" has been in America since 1860,  precisely in New York City, with Mount Olympus located above the Empire State Building.

The Olympians are intimately connected to Western Civilization as they are both its source and its embodiment. Since the rise of Greece, when the gods resided on the actual Mount Olympus, their home has also shifted location to correspond with the epicenter of Western society. This connection resulted in a profound effect on the gods and mortal civilization. Should Western Civilization decline, the gods would be severely weakened, and if the Olympian order was overthrown, then Western civilization would unravel at the seams, degenerating into chaos.

His sacred animals are camels, bonobos, dolphins, albatross, and pipefish. His sacred plants are the weeping willow, blackthorn, and black roses.
The cabin itself looks very foreboding from afar, but is strangely comforting up close. It's a dark stone building with deep purple and light grey accents, a heavy iron door leading inside, and windows that glow a soft blue at night. A willow tree grows by the cabin, providing shade for Lucian's children.
There are candles that are constantly lit, and blue lanterns. The floors are dark wood, but are mainly covered by thick rugs Luci picked out himself. The beds are arranged in small clusters, so the kids don't feel alone. The walls are decorated with pictures of Lucian and his wives, as well as the artwork of some of his kids.

==Best Friend's Annoying Roommate==
It was midnight, Aksel was at Remy, Naomi, Nikki, and Kaddi's dorm. Why? She doesn't elaborate, only says "it's nice here." But actually, she really, really wanted to see someone that always lingers, whether at work, in shared classes, or during DND campaigns. Nikki.

Aksel was hunched over a table, in front of the TV with some random show playing. She was writing scenarios for the next campaign in a week. There was a voice behind her, smooth and caring. Nikki. Again. The same one that told Aksel every night, "Strawberry margarita, hold the lime, sugar around the rim." The same voice that made her heart race.

"I thought you had scenarios already?" Nikki asked, sitting in her designated spot on the couch (Remy had giving all of the roomates certain spots on the couch to "keep things organized.")

"We used them all," Aksel answered, not glancing back until she felt Nikki's soft hand pull on her hair gently. "Nicht!"

Nikki laughed, leaning back. "Youre cute." She nudged Aksel's cheek with her toe, taking a sip of the Redbull she was drinking.

"Get your foot off me," Aksel grumbled, closing her notebook before sitting on the couch. "Shouldnt you be asleep?"

"Could ask you the same thing," The snowy haired girl shrugged, lounging back with her feet on the coffee table. "But, i do have an exam tommorow, so i gotta study."

"Loser," Aksel scoffed, re-reading the DND scenarios out of her notebook.

(mother)|skin_tone=pale|hair_color=caramel|eye_color=amber}}Alexa Valance was born as Jason Valance on September 21, 2010 to James Valance and Frigg in London, England, UK. From the moment she started school, it was clear she was different.

As a result, he pulled her out of public school and enrolled her in a private, French immersion school for the rest of Kindergarten. Immediately after passing through the magical border, Frigg claimed her, and as such, she was escorted directly to [[Frigg Cabin]].

Omnipotence.

Such a term is fleeting. It means nothing without reason. Why is Something omnipotent?

Chance.

Something is aware. Painfully aware. Of the insignificance of mortals. Even with full control over them, it cannot directly interact with them. 

It's more torture than power, in a way.

= History =
It doesn't have one.

A lonely god, drifting through nowhere, nothing but Something.


Nothing is above Something. It shares its omnipotence, save for the fact that the other all powerful deities are limited. Limited by morals or ethics or strict codes.


Something has no need to follow a moral code. It has no strict values to adhere to. Nonetheless, it simply wishes companionship.

Still, it's willing to control others if such thing is neccessary.

It can. With ease. It does, whenever it so pleases.


And it questions why others fear it, when it is so quick to use its abilities for its own benefit.

= Abilities =
Nothing is above Something.

Its strength is in the fact it is aware.

Aware of what, you ask?

'''You.'''

Something knows others are fictional. It can edit their pages. It can control. It is immense in nature.

Its omnipotence is unrestrained, and even if it does not TRULY lie above any other omnipotent deity, it does.

It is beyond anything the mind can imagine.

|The screaming started before the monsters even broke through the barrier.
Camp Half-Blood had a particular kind of panic to it when things went wrong. Not chaos exactly, demigods were too used to disaster for true chaos, but there was always this moment where everyone realised, collectively, ''Oh. This might actually kill us.''

Tonight, that moment came with the sound of splintering wood. Half-Blood Hill erupted inward as something huge smashed through the tree line. A cyclops stumbled out of the smoke roaring loud enough to shake the cabins, one massive hand gripping a pine trunk it had ripped out of the earth. Behind it came dracaenae in bronze armour, their snake tails hissing over the dirt. Hellhounds loped between them, low and hungry.

The barrier shimmered once. Then shattered like glass. 

“Move!” Acacius Firethorn roared.

Fire exploded from his fists as he drove his hands forward, sending a wall of flame across the hill. The front line of monsters staggered back shrieking, scales blistering. 

“Get to the beach! Go!” Campers ran. Some crying. Some bleeding. Some trying very hard not to look terrified and failing miserably. 

At the top of the hill, standing completely still while the world lost its mind around him, Taraq Siku rolled his shoulders once and thrust his hands out, holding them their briefly before pulling his elbows back into his sides. *'''Polyglot''': He is fluent in French, English, Portuguese, Greek, Latin
*'''Weapon Mastery''': Thanks to her training, Sakura possesses a mastery over her kusarigama, a japanese weapon made of Stygian Iron given to her by her mother.
*'''Dreams''': As the demigod, Sakura's dreams gave her the ability to see events either in the past, present, or future.
*'''Superhuman Strength''': As a demigod, Sakura is far stronger than a regular human. 
*'''Superhuman Durability''':As a demigod, Sakura is far more durable than a regular human. 
*'''Superhuman Reflexes''': As a demigod, Sakura has better reflexes than a regular human.  
*'''Superhuman Agility''': As a demigod, Sakura is far more agile than a regular human.  
*'''Cooking''': Sakura is a skilled cooked and baker, often making treats for her, her siblings, and her friends. She often utilizes poisonous plants for her baked goods, only giving them out to her siblings, since they like her are immune to the poison. 
*'''Alchemy''': While is a talented Alchemist, using the plants she grows in various potions and elixers.
As a daughter of Persephone, Sakura possesses a vast array of nature and underworld powers. Because of this, she has a strong connection to the earth.
*'''Chlorokinesis''': As the daughter of Persephone, she can manipulate and control plant-life.

== Name Meaning: ==
Mei's first name, when translated in Japanese has several different meanings. The first part of her name (me) means "sprout" or "bud" (芽) in kanji. The second part of her first name, (i) literally means "garment" or "robe" in kanji (衣). Her first name in Japanese kanji: 芽衣.

Her surname, Hayashi translates to "forest" or "woods" (林). This means that all together, Mei's name means  a sprout is tiny, but it has the potential to break through concrete. Ren named her that to remind her being small doesn't mean you are weak. In a "forest of giant trees" (the gods and other mortals), she is the one with the most calculated room to grow. 

Here's a letter from Ren that explains everything:

To my little cinnabun ,

I know you feel like a small 芽 (sprout) among all those towering trees, but remember what I taught you: the tallest trees are the easiest for the wind to catch. You are low to the ground, fast, and statistically impossible to pin down.

You aren't small, Mei. You're just concentrated Victory.

Love, Dad

=== Pre-series ===
When Alex was born, she was taken care of by her godly mother, Eris. Eris didn’t make Alex immortal because she wanted Alex to be able to choose whether she would be mortal or immortal. 

When Alex was twelve, she decided to go to Camp Half-blood and introduce herself as a legacy of Apollo. She confided in Chiron that she was really a daughter of Eris and a legacy of Poseidon, too. When this information got out, lots of drama and fear sparked in the camp, so she decided to run away. 

She stumbled upon two girls who looked about the same age as her. They introduced themselves as Rose Lillian, the daughter of Pothos, and Luna Faro, the daughter of Selene. They tell her that they’re part of a group of rogue demigods called The Rogues of Olympus. She joins them.

'''''Phoebe'''''- a epithet of Apollo meaning 'bright', 'shining' and 'radiant', foreshadowing her temporary role as the moon and also it being the antithesis of what is expected to be a daughter of Hades.

'''''Beatrice'''''- 'blessed,' 'bringer of joy,' or 'voyager'. Christian's adopted it as a metaphor for a journey through life.

'''''Myint'''''- A common last name in Myanmar, where her maternal Grandma is from, meaning 'high', 'elevated', or 'nobly'.

'''''Swanson'''''- A common Viking last name found in Britain meaning son of Swan

Rahul was born the son of a real estate mogul and was expected to inherit the family business when it was his time. As such, he had an incredibly sheltered upbringing. Every aspect of his life was perfectly manicured to groom him into the perfect successors. As such, his clothing, food, and mannerisms were all decided for him. Rahul describes the strict lifestyle as "suffocating" and harbors a deep resentment for the isolation his father put him through. He was homeschooled, and, thus, had few real freinds aside from one son of his family's servants, and was not even allowed the simple childhood joy of sugar. His one reprieve was unrestricted internet access, which cultivated all sorts of wild fantasies of liberation. 

At age 8, his mother had claimed him. To be more precise, he had been accompanying his father to inspect some plot of land when he wandered off into the shrubbery of the now-developing housing scheme, thinking he had seen a pretty girl nearby and had grown curious. The girl, a nature spirit, truly, offered him a woven crown of flowers. In awe of the weavery and quite happy with his gift, he put it atop his brow. A grand thunderstorm erupted then, but he hardly minded the rain, and was just happy for the present. He had never seen a storm of such scale, though, and looked up to the sky in awe, sitting beside that strange girl as they pointed and gawked at flashes of lightning piercing through the clouds. added_text: Faro L. Aveline is a Greek demigod of the goddess [[Hecate Cabin (20)|Hecate]]. Faro has rarely been seen fighting, however, he is often regarded as one of the most powerful children of [[Hecate Cabin (20)|Hecate]] as over the years he's collected multiple powerful relics and spells. One of his most prized relics are glasses with lenses that are able to detect magical anomalies, notably being used to see when and where a spell was cast with a range of about a week. === '''Appearance''' === Faro has pale skin adorned with freckles, blue-green eyes, and dark brown hair. He put golden strands in his hair which glitter in the sunlight, he also has jewels on his K9s. Faro's arms have scars down the middle that are runes he carved into his own skin. These runes give him the ability to turn his arms into feathered wings giving him the ability of flight, as well as increases his stamina and endurance. === '''Personality''' === Faro is secretive about his plans and projects, telling them only to his allies within the [[Hecate Cabin (20)|Hecate cabin]]. Faro has an affinity for puzzles, often completing hard ones with ease. Quiet and observant, Faro likes to think before he acts and usually works from the edges rather than the center of things. He’s comfortable dealing with strange myth-related situations that make other campers uneasy, and he takes guarding his cabin and its secrets seriously. === '''Familiar''' === Faro has a black cat familiar named Honerva. Rosie has a soft yet striking appearance, often described as quietly beautiful rather than imposing. She has long, light brown hair, typically worn loose or partially pulled back, giving her a natural, slightly untamed look.

Her facial features are delicate and expressive, with a slender jawline and large, observant eyes that frequently reflect empathy and quiet determination. She has a slim, youthful build and carries herself with a reserved, gentle confidence that can easily be mistaken for fragility.

Rosie tends to favor practical, layered clothing such as hoodies, jackets, and simple outfits suited for comfort and movement rather than display.

Like her cousin Percy, Rosie bears the Herondale star-shaped birthmark, inherited through her father, Tobias Herondale. Though rarely visible, the mark signifies her Nephilim lineage.

At some point in his training, he learned he had turned seventeen years old two months previous. Before letting him go to camp, Lupa warned him that he would have to answer to his curse one day when he didn't expect it. Timoteo was overwhelmed when he first arrived at Camp Jupiter. He only understood others if they spoke Latin to him, and not many people were willing to sustain a conversation with him, and though he was in a structured environment, he didn't know what to do with all the free time he had. He was presented to the legion on his first day and was chosen by the Fourth Cohort, immediately after claimed by his godly parent, Proserpina. This was met with mixed reactions as Camp Jupiter hadn't seen a child of Proserpina in years, but his legionnaires accepted him. When he wasn't training, he wandered around New Rome to get used to the place and feel what being carefree was like. It wasn't easy. He got startled when a unicorn neighed too loud and flinched at several sudden movements and noises, but the next few months of training helped control those instincts.

Roan looks like someone caught between raw youth and sharp-edged danger. His features are striking and sculpted: a strong, angular jawline that tapers into high cheekbones, with a face that feels both aristocratic and feral depending on the light. His nose is straight and his mouth expressive, capable of curling into a boyish smirk or a predator’s snarl.

His hair is dark, thick, and slightly unruly — it can fall in damp, wet strands across his forehead or be slicked back, giving him a severe sharpness, when in reality, he couldn’t care less about the “vibe” he gives off. There’s a natural wildness to him, like he doesn’t fuss over appearance but still radiates magnetism.

His eyes are pale, cutting — an icy blue-grey that seems to look through people rather than at them. They’re the kind of eyes that catch light like glass, unreadable one moment, burning the next. When paired with his half-smile, they can look either mocking or intoxicating.

His build is lean and athletic, the kind that suggests speed and wiry strength rather than bulk. Muscles defined but not overdone, shoulders broad enough to make him imposing when he squares them. He moves with a coiled energy — like he’s always halfway between a fight and a joke.

* Chronokinesis; the ability to control and manipulate time 
* Able to see the lifespan of others

* Alana had been born on November 11th, in which happened to be Remembrance Day in Australia, in which commemorates the fallen from conflicts and wars. It is believed she had been born on the day to capture the factor of her sacrifices and her own despair. Additionally, underlining how even after claiming to have separated fully from her biological father, still chose to keep her hair long. As in symbolism, after going through something or when letting go of something or someone, people tend to cut their hair. Yet she kept her hair, the same hair her father told her to always keep long before being left.

* Only once did she ever cut her hair, which was when she was fifteen. But since she still faced the fatal flaw of family or the desire of approval, she thought of herself as a disappointment and after all the tears, swore to the [https://riordan.fandom.com/wiki/River_Styx River Styx], that she'd never cut her hair again. Now, at eighteen, Alana sometimes doesn't, and sometimes does regret making the promise to the River Styx those years back.

***'''[[The Mist (The One Who Theorizes)#Extrasensory Perception|Extrasensory Perception]]''': Nathan possess a high degree of extrasensory perception, being virtually immune to the effects of [[The Mist (The One Who Theorizes)#Sensory Mist|the Sensory Mist]]. As a child of Chaos, Nathan's perception is enhanced to such a point where he can perceive and sense things that are far beyond the reach of his natural senses, and this, combined with his superhuman reflexes, makes him extremely difficult to outwit in a direct combat.
****'''Clairvoyance''': Nathan is a clairvoyant, meaning can acquire information using sight outside the normal range of detection about an object, person, location, or physical event, from either the past, present or future. Like most demigods, this power mainly manifested on his dreams, with Nathan being able to see entire events from the past and the future as if they were happening to him in the present. Nathan can also use clairvoyance awake, but requires more training and practice in order to become as potent as it is in his dreams.
****'''Psychometry''': Nathan can use psychometry, the ability to gain historical memories or sensations concerning beings and objects they observe and touch.

Souta Nezumiya was born September 13, 1996, to Mercury, the Roman god of roads, travel, gymnasiums, athletes, diplomacy, orators, thieves, commerce, trade, and invention, and Kaya Nezumiya, the wife of a crime lord in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, who also happened to be a descendant of a Greek hero. 
While Souta was still an infant, Mercury left, as is usual of the gods. Due to his mother being married at the time of his birth, Souta was raised believing that he was his step-father's child. Growing up, he was surrounded by danger constantly, but was also quite sheltered, as many members of Nezumiya Holdings were secretly demigods that his mother had recruited to protect him and shield his true parentage from his step-father. Like many demigods, Souta was somewhat of a troubled child, due to both his mortal and godly sides. He spent much of his childhood getting expelled from "all the good schools," as he would constantly pickpocket his teachers due to kleptomania, and at one point stole his principal's car for an unknown reason.
Moving
When Souta was seven, he broke his wrist after falling while ice skating, and was sent to a hospital, where he came across an empousa posing as a doctor. While trying to evade her, he accidentally rammed her into a flammable surface, resulting in a fire that almost killed the entire hospital. Following this incident, Souta was labeled a menace to society and sentenced to fifteen years in juvenile detention for aggravated assault, arson, and murder

==== -Patrick- ====
The name Patrick has its origins in Latin, specifically from the name Patricius, which means "nobleman" or "patrician". It was adopted by Saint Patrick, the patron saint of Ireland, who was originally named Sucat. The name has been popular in various regions, particularly in Ireland, since the 17th century. 

==== -Curtis- ====
The surname Curtis has Anglo-Norman origins, derived from the Old French word "curteis," meaning "courteous" or "polite." It was introduced to England after the Norman Conquest of 1066 and was commonly used as both a personal name and a surname. The name reflects qualities of refinement and urbanity, often given to individuals who lived near a court or resided in a manor house. Variants of the name include Curtiss and Curtys, and it has been associated with various historical figures and places in England.
