== History ==

=== Early Life ===
Britomartis had chosen Mr. Kato, a clear-sighted mortal for a hunting partner, and the two hunted before Mr. Kato accidentally shot a red fox, mistaking it for a prey animal. Though Britomartis found the shot clean but not exactly a worthy catch, as she would for a usual hunting partner, she still obliged to take it to herself for a child, since Mr. Kato felt sorry for the animal and begged her to take it. Britomartis became pregnant and soon had Andromache, leaving her with Mr. Kato.

Despite being born from mercy, Andromache had no space for her own. She fought with her classmates constantly so that she could feel victorious over them, and grew up with sociopathic tendencies, not considering or caring for others' feelings. She thought being a demigod was special, and hoped to be like her mother, whom she admired, but hard to say loved, as Andromache could not feel love. At most, she tolerated her affectionate father. She was cold, and manipulated others when she wanted something. At twelve, she stole her father's hunting rifle and shot a fox with it. Exapserated, Mr. Kato sent her to Camp Half-Blood, hoping demigod companionship would stir something within her.

=== Demi-primordial ===
'''Demi‑Primordial''' are extremely rare hybrid beings born from a '''Primordial Entity'''—such as Gaia, Erebus, Tartarus, Nyx, or Aether—and a '''mortal parent'''. The term was officially coined by '''Baraka Mtajiri''' on ''February 26, 2026'', and has since been recognized as a distinct classification in mytho‑cosmic hierarchies

Unlike demigods, who are children of gods, '''Demi‑Primordial Children exist above the divine spectrum''', often possessing raw cosmic abilities inherited directly from the forces that shaped existence.

They are '''not demi gods'''—they are '''the stronger than standards demigods'''

=== THEOMANCERS ===
'''Theomancers''' are extremely rare hybrid beings created from the union of a '''magician''' and a '''full deity''' (not a demigod). This makes them fundamentally distinct from Demicians.

Theomancers stand at the threshold between mortal spellcasters and divine entities, possessing enough divine essence to be classified as '''near-minor gods'''.

They are not worshipped as deities in most cultures —

but they ''could be''.

=== egyptian magician ===
, magicians (''shesh'') are <mark>trained practitioners of ancient Egyptian magic, organized under the House of Life to maintain order (Ma'at)</mark>. Unlike demigods, they rely on amulets, hieroglyphic spells, divine words, and sometimes "the path of the gods" to battle chaos forces. Powerful magicians often possess the blood of the pharaohs they can hosts gods

== Appearance ==
Pale skin (like someone who rarely sees the sun and has spent a long time in a sarcophagus), gray-platinum eyes, blond hair. When he uses his powers or thinks deeply, his skin and eyes momentarily shimmer with a faint golden and silver glow, as if liquid metal were moving beneath them. This is an involuntary reaction that he tries to control by putting his hands in his pockets or turning away.

== Personality ==
Theodore understands that he is not human. He has known this since the moment he awoke, just as he knows his name. It is not a question of self-identification, but a fundamental, indisputable fact of his existence, just as the sky is blue. He was created for a mission. At first, he moved like a programmed droid: find shelter, obtain resources, search for information about Tartarus.

But his unique nature—a soul woven from the fragments of legionnaires' souls—is not just a database, it is his “humanity.” These are not voices in his head, but rather:

* '''Vague mental images:''' When he sees Roman architecture, he may involuntarily feel a warm sense of nostalgia, even though he has never been to Rome himself.
* '''Muscle memory:''' He is a master of the gladius and tactics, although no one taught him this; he received this information from the reformed shadow of the centurion of the Fifth Cohort, Alcyoneus,

==Society==
Just like the gods have their hierarchy, the demigods also have one, which laregely mirrors that of the gods.

===The Demigod Monarchs===
The supreme leader and ruler of the demigod race is the King/Queen of the Demigods, also known as the Demigod Monarch or the Half-Blood Eminence. This role is given to the children of Chaos when they reach and unleash the full extent of their power, and because they can emanate an aura of authority, almost all demigods will naturally follow, obey and support them. They also have mirrored demigod monarchs of other godly domains (e.g. the Demigod King/Queen of the Sea, the Ghost King/Queen, etc).

Differently from the godly monarchy, the demigod monarchy is greatly democratic and elective, which means a demigod can openly oppose, protest, criticize and defy their leaders without fear of oppresion, reprisals, brutality and authoritarian response.

Unlike most people with ASPD, Melanie isn't actually very impulsive. She is highly aware of her decisions, even though as a kid her impulsion was more defined. But when she grew up, she became calculating in her movements, even the small things she was completely conscious of. Because everything had underlying intent with her, like a sense of unpredictability at how she would approach someone or something. Even though she has very intrusive thoughts, she enacts them with a sense of deliberateness that makes even the self-assured uncertain of her decisions, of whether they're as bad as they seem. Presenting her ideas in luxurious drapes; cladded in temptation that she had mastered at making undeniable. Her insatiable hunger driving her to dress herself in someone's appetite naturally.  

Nonetheless, her cruel nature is completely disregarded by the majority. Her appeal is something she built herself, making others swoon or others be enticed by the way she holds herself. Her mannerisms perfected to a detail, her choice of words meant to send shivers down someone's spines. Her seduction is difficult to surpass, because it isn't some pure form of seduction, it is a dark, doom-looming seduction. Like she presents herself as an equal and offers someone their favorite food. Melanie relishes in being relied on, gradually making people dependent on her, on her approval, of her always being there for them.

=== '''Core Traits:''' === He is very chatty and empathetic, Finn thrives on connection. He genuinely wants to know people: what makes them tick, what they love, what hurts them. He talks a lot, but it’s rarely shallow: his questions are thoughtful, and he remembers answers months later. He is also sweet and pleasant, strangers often walk away smiling after meeting him. He has that energy: open, approachable, and unintimidating. He notices when someone seems off, and adjusts his behavior: softens his voice, offers them a stim toy, or cracks a silly fox fact to lighten the mood. But below all the surface sweetness and bubliness there's a sharp and fiercly protective interior, he’s laser-precise when it comes to people he loves. If someone threatens or insults them, Finn drops the sunshine and becomes uncomfortably direct. His empathy gives him a natural sense of where to “strike” in words, he will cut deep if he has to.
Flaw:'''
Too Trusting: His warmth is also his weakness. He believes too easily in others’ goodness, assumes everyone means what they say, and overlooks red flags until it’s too late. He’s vulnerable to being manipulated. He also tends to share more about himself than is safe (especially with people he just met). To him, being open feels like kindness—he doesn’t always realize how risky that can be.

====Races====
The known immortal races are the Protogenoi, Titans, Kronides and Gigantes. It seems like each time a sovereign have children and the Fates have decided for a new generation to take over, the children of the sovereign will belong to another race of immortals, though it can also happen if a immortal with control over fertility willingly decides to give birth to a new race.

=====Protogenoi=====
The '''Protogenoi''' (sing. '''Protogenos''', also known as the '''primordial gods''') are the first race of immortals to come into existence and were born directly from the void of [[Chaos (The One Who Theorizes)|Chaos]]. Unlike the Titans and Kronides, they are essentially sentient aspects of the universe itself and have absolute and total control over it, so therefore they cannot truly be killed. As they are the very components that make up the universe, Protogenoi have complete control of the domain they represent, which can rival or even exceed that of gods who preside over them. In addition, all the Protogenoi wield immeasurable power, rendering them the most powerful beings in the universe.

As the sentient aspects of the Universe itself, all Protogenoi are incapable of truly dying. Even if they were to be scattered and their physical form permanently destroyed, they would remain both alive and immortal.

== Powers ==
'''Balance Manipulation''' — The ability to sense and influence imbalances, bringing situations, forces, or outcomes closer to equilibrium.

'''Retribution''' — The ability to cause consequences to those who deliberately harm or wrong others.

'''Luck Manipulation''' — The ability to increase or decrease someone’s luck, causing fortunate or unfortunate outcomes.

'''Consequence Sense''' — The ability to sense the possible consequences of someone’s actions.

'''Enhanced Perception''' — The ability to notice things others might miss, especially inconsistencies, deception, unfairness, and hidden details.

'''Combat Instincts''' — Naturally enhanced instincts in combat, allowing Harluxly to quickly recognize an opponent’s weaknesses and react to attacks.

'''Limited Curse Casting''' — The ability to place temporary curses, particularly curses involving misfortune or consequences, on someone who has seriously wronged another.

'''Equalization''' — The ability to temporarily reduce an overwhelming advantage, bringing two opposing sides closer to an equal level of power

'''Tychokinesis''' — Manipulation of luck, allowing Harluxly to increase or decrease someone’s luck, particularly to restore balance.

'''Justice Manipulation''' — The ability to influence or enforce justice when an imbalance or wrongdoing has occurred.

'''Vengeance Manipulation''' — The ability to channel or manipulate the desire for vengeance against someone who has caused harm.

If [https://epicthemusical.fandom.com/wiki/Penelope Penelope] had a business card, it would read: “Patience. Purposeful deception. Sofa available.” Her cabin smells of wool, wood, and simmering plans. Nothing here is over-the-top: there are no thrones or banners, just weaving tables, an olive tree where promises are hung, and a room where the brain cells (and fingernails) of the aspirants are tested. The claim is subtle: a fleeting loom on the collarbone and a feeling that haste has just lost a round. Being a member of this cabin isn't about learning to wait: it's about learning to buy time—how to procrastinate with style, how to set traps that look like accidents, and how to stay calm when everything else is on fire. (Note: it also doubles as excellent cover for hiding supplies and secrets.)

Melanie is said to be portrayed as someone worse than even her mother when it comes to terms of their personalities. She's an unfeeling person who fits the term 'sociopath' almost completely. Viewed as someone who is incapable of feeling anything, especially for her peers. The underlying cruelty in her actions stems from her personality, that has no remorse for those around her. She takes pleasure in toying with those around her, utilizing them for personal gain or simply to satisfy her unusual ideology of being the intangible. The roots of her personality come directly from her mother, however, though it isn't from her father, it is said her father only further fueled her apathetic tendencies and her inability to express any sort of guilt for her actions. When she was younger, medical professionals speculated that she had severe bipolar disorder, to which this was outrightly rejected by her father. He wholeheartedly believed she was a perfect angel, who could never even utter a singular lie, under the belief she was Aletheia's untouchable daughter. Consequently, Melanie believed herself as someone whose words were in the pursuit of righteousness and necessity rather than deception and lies. She was the root of where her mortal half-siblings became vindictive, seeing no matter how persistent they were of her deceit, their father would never believe them. Thus, sustaining and further energizing Melanie's desire to watch them crumble and be easily twisted around underneath her

== <big>Appearance</big> == The village’s sky is almost always clear, although if Chaos is in a really bad mood, the sky will be dark and stormy. == Powers and Traits. ==

==== '''Common Powers:''' ====

* '''Mist Manipulation''', every child of Lilinoe will be born with the ability to manipulate/summon a layer of mist. How thick the layer of mist will be will vary on the skill and strength of the child.
* '''Hydrokinesis'''. '''The ability to control water''', this ability isn’t as powerful as other water deities, but the strength of the ability will vary for every child.
* '''Temperature Control''', only a small amount of Lilinoe children cannot control the temperature around them.
* '''Various Temperature Withstand''', children of Lilinoe can withstand freezing temperatures and boiling temperatures, no matter how cold or hot.
* '''Cryokinesis'''. '''The ability to control ice''', this ability once again isn’t as powerful as other snow deities, though the strength of the ability will vary for every child.
* '''Frigokinesis'''. '''The ability to control snow''', this power is as strong as other snow gods, but every child has a different skill set than others.
* '''Fire Suppression'''. As Lilinoe was known for putting out the goddess, Pele, fires out, her children inherited the ability to put out fires at will. But they can only ''put'' the fires out.
* '''Healing Mist'''. It’s in the name, children of Lilinoe can heal themselves or others with the mist they summon or mist that is already there.

===White House Peace Summit===
In early 2025, Kali Vries traveled directly to Washington, D.C., to spearhead the high-level interior security grid for the monumental Peace Summit hosted at the White House. This high-profile international conference, prominently featured during the events of Captain America: Brave New World, brought together the United Nations Security Council, GRC officials, and world leaders to negotiate global security measures regarding the physical remnants of the Celestial Tiamut. Running point on the capital's interior defense alongside U.S. Agent John Walker, Kali utilized her S.H.I.E.L.D. counter-espionage training to establish an air-gapped biometric screening network, ensuring that no corporate cleanup crews or deep-state mercenaries could infiltrate the executive ballroom.

The diplomatic proceedings collapsed into absolute, chaotic warfare when the criminal mastermind Burton Horowitz unleashed a devastating, localized psychological broadcast signal directly inside the executive perimeter. This targeted mental assault instantly triggered deep-seated neurological conditioning within select superhuman assets present at the capital, abruptly brainwashing the legendary Isaiah Bradleyand forcing him to violently turn against the summit's delegation. As heavy physical devastation tore through the main ballroom and structural masonry collapsed under the weight of the super-powered assault, Kali’s crisis training immediately took over. (A.A)|Celestial]]}}'''Devron the Experimenter''' is a [[Celestials (A.A)|Celestial]], classified as a junior member of his race. == Biography == Devron the Experimenter was first implanted as a seed within an unknown planet, emerging through the intelligence of the planet’s population. Though considered a junior Celestial, Devron is better known for his curiosity and experiments than for the world‑shaping duties of elder Celestials. Unlike towering Celestials such as Arishem, Devron’s stature is relatively small, roughly the size of a moon, making him an anomaly among his colossal kin. In his early assignments, Devron was tasked with observing Earth alongside his brother, Gamiel the Manipulator, another junior Celestial. Earth hosted a growing Celestial seed that would eventually become Tiamut the Communicator, making it the site of one of Devron’s largest experiments. Their work focused on theory testing rather than judgments or planetary engineering, though their competitive nature drove Devron to push the limits of planetary systems. 1954-1973
In late August, seismometers aboard a JMSDF patrol aircraft and U.S. Sixth Fleet vessels recorded anomalous seismic activity southwest of the Izu Islands, followed by the incineration of several Japanese trawlers. The Japanese Self-Defense Forces, consulting with the U.S. Navy’s Deep Ocean Surveillance systems, identified the source—a colossal marine reptilian organism now known as ''Gojira'', powered by internal nuclear fusion sustained from mantle isotope catalysts. To prevent public alarm during the Cold War, the National Security Council and Japan’s National Security Secretariat agreed on a cover story: a series of “undersea seismic calibration tests” by oil and gas companies, including Inpex and JX Nippon Oil, had triggered the events. Acoustic deterrence systems and thermal decoys were quietly deployed across the Pacific Rim.
In October, a damaged biological re-entry capsule landed near Cle Elum, Washington. Recovered by a joint DARPA–NIH team operating under
codename “Project Ararat,” its occupants—eventually called Goku and Vegeta—displayed radically slow ageing due to telomerase-activated cellular regeneration. They were placed in renewable cryo-stasis at Camp Humphreys in South Korea for decades, only awakened when global threats necessitated their deployment. The Ministry of Defence of Japan and the U.S. Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency continued remote genetic monitoring, ensuring plausibility under national security mandates.

===Early Life===
====M.I.T. Breakthroughs====
Born with a hyper-advanced aptitude for cellular biology, Karlin "Karla" Malus quickly became an academic prodigy, earning full research honors during her tenure at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (M.I.T.). While her peers focused on standard gene therapies and cancer research, Malus became completely obsessed with tracking mutagenic acceleration and human physical enhancement. Her radical graduate thesis proposed methods to chemically rewrite human cellular walls to force hyper-regeneration—a paper that was immediately suppressed by the M.I.T. review board due to severe ethical violations regarding theoretical human testing. Deeply embittered by academia's rigid boundaries, Malus began conducting off-the-books, black-market gene-splicing experiments in unmapped underground labs around Boston, tracking down rare steroid compounds and cellular mutagens for high-paying criminal entities.

====Recruitment by Valentina====
Her underground operations and absolute lack of moral hesitation quickly flagged her on global intelligence networks, drawing the direct attention of Valentina Allegra de Fontaine. Recognizing Malus as a once-in-a-generation talent who valued scientific progress over human law, Valentina intercepted her during a black-market compound raid. Instead of executing or imprisoning her, Valentina offered Malus total legal immunity, unlimited dark-budget government resources, and a permanent position within the C.

== Appearance ==
America is a beautiful woman in her late twenties. She has thick auburn that reaches below her shoulders, forest green eyes, fair skin and a slender, womanly figure.

== Relationships ==

=== Tony Stark ===
Tony is America's older brother who raised her after the death of their parents when she was a baby. They have a very close bond, as he was the only family she had, and Tony was known to be a very loving older brother to America, even coming to see her like a daughter. While he never ''planned'' on caring for a child, Tony made it very clear to his little sister that he loved her and that raising her gave him a purpose outside of Stark Industries. He even ended up adopting her as his actual child, making her the heir to Stark Industries.

===Equipment===
*'''Leviathan Stealth Suit''': Isabelle wears a highly advanced, insulated tactical bodysuit designed by Soviet intelligence networks. The suit features localized body armor plating capable of deflecting small-arms gunfire and shrapnel, while its specialized polymer weave renders her virtually invisible to thermal imaging and standard radar arrays.
*'''Leviathan Gauntlets''': Positioned on her forearms, these heavily modified bracers function similarly to the traditional Widow's Bite but utilize salvaged Hydra cybernetic tech. They allow Isabelle to discharge powerful, high-voltage electrical bursts, project localized magnetic grapples for rapid scaling, and deploy micro-wire garrotes for silent takedowns.
*'''Tactical Biometric Mask''': During her solo infiltration missions, Isabelle utilizes a specialized, lower-face rebreather and HUD visor. This gear filters out airborne toxins and nerve gases while feeding live structural schematics, structural weak points, and thermal heart rates directly into her field of vision.

===Weapons===
*'''Dual Leviathan Batons''': Isabelle's primary close-quarters combat weapons are a pair of collapsible, high-density alloy batons. These weapons can channel the electrical currents from her gauntlets to deliver incapacitating taser strikes, and they can lock together at the base to form a fully functional, long-range combat staff.

===Society & Culture===
Children have no voice in Shi'ar Society until they have passed the rite of passage. The Shi'ar were a warrior and arrogant race, having bred warriors that were held as the pinnacle of their civilization. The Shi'ar respected those who defeated or induced fear in them. From a young age, the Shi'ar were told to be strong and merciful, and not fall to their enemies' plea. 

The Shi'ar official language was known as Shi'arese. A Shi'ar "galaxian" stated that they "learn[ed] nearly every spoken languages". The Shi'ar have multiple forms, including the High Shi'ar, used for formal events, Shi'ar Prime, and Shi'ar Glorkon dialect. The Shi'ar language was mentioned to be highly gendered. Mostly for tactical terms or insults, the Shi'ar insert words of their language into English sentences.

The Shi'ar are defiant toward arts such as drawing or music. They considered that music distorted perception. They fought the Fianden, a species of artists, musicians, singers, painters and carvers... with such beautiful creations that it could enter the Shi'ar and destroy their minds, save for those "defective", able to dream. Although, the Shi'ar did not forbid arts on conquered worlds, and they at least produce theatre, such as the Absurdist Shi'ar play "The Spaceship That Wasn't There" (allegedly very "successful in its dialectic". ===Trained by [[Barnard McWilliams (Reality-199999)|Taskmaster]]===
At some point during the dark years since the [[Snap (Reality-199999)|Snap]] which [[Reality-199999|took half of life across the universe]], Lemar and his close companion, [[Jonathan Francis Walker (Reality-199999)|John Walker]], both voluntarily processed into an exclusive, high-security conditioning pipeline hosted within Taskmaster's [[Taskmaster's Academy|private academy]] for gifted and elite individuals. Seeking to elevate their physical performance and tactical intuition to the absolute apex of global intelligence standards, the duo underwent months of grueling, multi-layered training arrays supervised directly by [[Barnard McWilliams (Reality-199999)|Barnard "Barney" McWilliams]] himself.

Wielding his absolute Photographic Reflexes, Taskmaster personally sparred with the duo, forcing Lemar and John to adapt to an unpredictable combat matrix composed of copied Red Room, S.H.I.E.L.D., and Wakandan close-quarters fighting arts. He systematically ironed out their physical vulnerabilities, taught them to ground their stances under high-velocity attrition, and conditioned their minds to maintain flatline heart rates across volatile hot zones. This rigorous, heavy-handed conditioning successfully forged them into an uncompromised, independent wall of defense, perfectly preparing Lemar and John to maximize their subsequent super-soldier physiology and hold the absolute front lines for [[Human|humanity]] str
a civilization that can harness the entire energy in the universe,

In the months following the retirement of Steve Rogers, the United States government became fully aware of its desperate need for a new generation of global superheroes to rise and protect humanity from emerging, asymmetric threats—specifically the rising network of U.L.T.I.M.A.T.U.M., whose radical leader Anarchy actively sought to dismantle international borders. This political urgency escalated dramatically after Sam Wilson, who had been hand-picked and trusted to become the next Captain America by Rogers himself, officially donated Captain America's Shield to the Smithsonian Institution in Washington, D.C., feeling a profound personal weight that left him believing he could not yet fulfill Rogers' massive legacy.

The iconic vibranium shield was quickly seized from the museum vaults by the United States Department of Defense and handed directly to Adam Walker, the highly decorated cousin of Jonathan Francis Walker and the designated commander of the Bold Urban Commandos (B.U.C.s). Backed by the executive authority of Senator Harold Callahan, Lemar Hoskins and his close tactical partner, Jules Edeiman, officially agreed to support Adam’s appointment, recognizing that while Adam was not yet an enhanced super-soldier, he possessed the peak baseline conditioning to become one if he successfully proved his worth during his upcoming global field trials. == Heart Shaped Enhancement ==

* Consumption of the Heart-Shaped Herb grants superhuman physical abilities, including enhanced strength, speed, stamina, durability, reflexes, agility, and combat instincts. For example, T’Challa demonstrated enhanced strength by lifting a person with one hand and moving at speeds described by T’Challa as “as fast as a zebra.” These enhancements elevate the user’s physical capabilities to levels comparable to a super soldier, allowing them to perform feats far beyond normal human limits. The effects of the herb can be temporarily negated by a specialized preparation, which is traditionally used in Wakanda during combat trials to ensure fair contests for the Black Panther mantle and the role of King of Wakanda.
* Developed by Shuri, this modified artificial Heart-Shaped Herb was engineered to induce epigenetic alterations rather than temporary physiological enhancement. When consumed during pregnancy, it permanently integrates enhanced traits into fetal development, reinforcing muscular, skeletal, neurological, and regenerative systems at a genetic expression level. Unlike the traditional herb, these enhancements cannot be negated or removed, as they are not an active effect but a natural part of the individual’s biology from birth.

==Biography==
===Early Life===
Born into the upper echelon of the global intelligence community, Contessa Bianca Demonico de Fontaine was raised from infancy within the cold, uncompromising parameters of deep-state conspiracies. As the secret biological daughter of Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, Bianca’s identity was aggressively scrubbed from all international birth registries, public records, and conventional C.I.A. human resources databases. She was never given the luxury of a normal childhood; instead, Valentina hand-picked elite tactical trainers, black-market psychological experts, and deep-cover espionage veterans to forge her daughter into the ultimate weapon of counter-intelligence. Bianca grew up traveling between unmapped safe houses and off-grid military black sites, internalizing the strict belief that national laws and ethical boundaries were merely regulatory illusions designed to govern the weak.

Throughout her adolescent years, Bianca became an exceptional phantom operative, assisting her mother in the shadows as Valentina quietly navigated the ranks of the C.I.A. and began laying the groundwork for what would eventually become the rogue O.X.E. division. Bianca mastered the art of weaponized empathy, learning how to effortlessly adopt false identities, manipulate foreign intelligence agents, and read human behavioral patterns with absolute, clinical precision. a fiercely independent and fiercely intelligent tech prodigy. Her brilliant scientific mind keeps her laser-focused on problem-solving. Furthermore, she can channel this energy inward to grant herself lightning speed, boosting physical reflexes and cognitive processing to peak levels via overcharged internal neural signaling. ==Background== '''Grant Gallagher Evans''' is the third-eldest Gallagher child and the most academic after his brother Lip. He is a straight-A student with an 8.9 GPA and an astonishing 486 IQ, making him one of the most intellectually gifted teenagers in the country. Despite being incredibly intelligent, Grant is still only fifteen years old and, physically, is nowhere near as capable as the highly trained soldiers around him. In 2011, Captain America was off-world, leaving the United States without its greatest super-soldier. President Barack Obama had begun looking for someone who could potentially take up the mantle of Captain America should the need arise. During the preparations for the Chicago Memorial Day Parade, General Raymond T. Odierno was serving as the Grand Marshal. Odierno had heard about a remarkably gifted fifteen-year-old named Grant Gallagher Evans and became fascinated by the boy's extraordinary intellect. While speaking with President Obama, General Odierno suggested that Grant could be an extraordinary asset to the United States military. He explained Grant's unbelievable intelligence and proposed that Obama personally recruit him into the Navy SEALs, believing that someone with an IQ of 486 could become an invaluable strategic asset. Obama was fascinated by the idea and agreed. On May 28, 2011, President Obama and General Odierno personally went to the Gallagher family home to find Grant. Overview
Vaarek Klrr is a stoic, highly disciplined Skrull agent of S.W.O.R.D., trained in covert operations, battlefield infiltration, and interstellar counterintelligence. A second-generation warrior from the respected House Klrr, he was born in exile after the destruction of Zaragz’na, but raised with the full military traditions and strategic expectations of his forebears.

Quiet, lethal, and precise, Vaarek is one of the few pure-blood Skrulls entrusted with first contact missions, internal threat suppression, and high-level asset retrieval across volatile sectors. Though not a politician, he has earned respect within the United Front for his honor, discipline, and unwavering code.

He operates most frequently alongside G’iah Drexxon-Warner, with whom he shares a bond built on shared loss, mutual respect, and countless field missions.

==Personality==
Alan Dean Saunders is portrayed as a conflicted yet principled individual whose sense of duty is gradually overtaken by his conscience. While he begins as a loyal officer within a system designed to combat vigilantes, he is not blind to the moral implications of his role. His internal struggle becomes evident when he witnesses the unjust killing of a young looter by his partner, an act that starkly contradicts the ideals of justice he believed he was upholding. Rather than suppressing his doubts, Saunders openly acknowledges the wrongdoing, revealing a grounded moral awareness and an unwillingness to rationalize excessive force simply because it is sanctioned by authority.

Earlier in his career, Alan Saunders admired the Punisher, even going so far as to mark himself with the symbol, suggesting he was once drawn to a more uncompromising and extrajudicial vision of justice. However, his firsthand exposure to the unchecked brutality within the [[V.I.G.I.L. (Reality-199999)|V.I.G.I.L.]] forces him to reassess those beliefs. The gap between the idealized notion of justice and its real-world execution becomes impossible for him to ignore. Choosing to assist Matt Murdock and Karen Page despite the risks involved demonstrates a decisive shift in his character, as he prioritizes ethical responsibility over loyalty to a corrupt system and the political power behind it.

* The Celestialsapiens become scholars of the Multiverse, watching over every event in every Universe, almost never intervening. However, when they judge necessary, the Celestialsapiens do get involved in the Multiverse's affairs. As they have become beings of near-omnipotent power, whenever a Celestialsapien is outside the Forge of Creation, they need permission of both [[Master Order (Heitorfred1)|Master Order]] and [[Lord Chaos (Heitorfred1)|Lord Chaos]] to perform any action - even if it is to merely move an arm.

Ever since becoming the friendly neighborhood hero of Queens, Peter Parker has struggled to balance his life as a teenager with the responsibilities that come with being Spider-Man. But when ruthless crime lord Tombstone rises to power, determined to claim the title of Kingpin from Wilson Fisk, Peter finds himself facing a threat unlike anything he has encountered before. Using a growing army of supervillains to eliminate Spider-Man and expand his influence beyond Queens, Tombstone forces Peter into a battle that will test everything he believes about being a hero. Joined by Daredevil, a seasoned vigilante who clashes with Peter over his age and inexperience, and the Punisher, a brutal figure who believes justice must
delivered by any means necessary, Spider-Man must prove that he is more than just a masked teenager chasing criminals. As Peter faces the dangers of the criminal underworld, he discovers what it truly means to become the '''Spectacular Spider-Man'''. Meanwhile, Peter’s personal life takes an unexpected turn when he is forced to tutor Flash Thompson, the school bully whose arrogant and carefree attitude hides struggles far deeper than anyone realizes. As Peter learns the truth behind Flash’s behavior, he begins to understand that being a hero means seeing the person behind the mask — both for his enemies and himself.

===Early Life===
Gavrel Achter lived a relatively quiet, unassuming life in New York, working diligently as a city sanitation worker. Despite his grounded routine and strong sense of civic duty, Achter struggled with persistent anxiety, an enduring feeling of alienation, and a deep-seated identity confusion. Seeking to stabilize his mental health and find emotional grounding, he eventually enrolled as a private patient under the care of noted S.H.I.E.L.D. consultant and psychologist Dr. Andrew Garner. Over the course of their therapeutic relationship, Achter developed a profound sense of trust in Garner, viewing the doctor as a vital anchor and a safe sanctuary for his internal vulnerabilities.

===[[Terrigen Wave (Reality-79159)|Terrigen Wave]]===

Unbeknownst to him, Achter possessed dormant Kree genetic markers that were violently triggered when he inadvertently ingested fish oil supplements contaminated with oceanic Terrigen trace elements. Plunged into a sudden and terrifying Terrigenesis, he emerged from his rocky cocoon transformed into a bald, gray-skinned Inhuman with emerging telekinetic and technopathic capabilities. == THE IMMORTAL: NO MASK, NO FACE ==
The Heavy rain came that night like punishment, not precipitation, hammering the narrow alley off St. Nicholas Avenue with a constant, stinging violence that blurred the lights of the elevated tracks overhead into sickly streaks of reflected neon on puddles filled with oil and garbage water. New York City in 2027 was no longer the bright, unshakeable presence it once was; under Mayor Wilson Fisk’s martial‑law Safer Streets Initiative, vigilantes were criminals, heroes were hunted, and the Anti‑Vigilante Task Force padded the streets with skull‑emblazoned vests and absolutist zealotry, their authority bolstered by the Mayor’s word and protected from civil oversight. Tonight, they had him pinned where the bricks sagged and the gutters reeked of rot, the narrow space a tomb of rusted metal and cracked concrete designed to swallow sound whole. He fell into the darkness like every other night—silent at first, posture coiled and ready—his boots splashing into the blackened fissures that ran like veins down the alley, his senses already scanning for threat and exit with preternatural precision. But he never got the chance to rise into movement before the world ripped into brightness.

===Early Life===
====Temporary Family Life====
Galina Anokhin was born in Moscow, Soviet Union, on February 15, 1989, into a bloodline already marked by the shadow of clandestine warfare. She was the biological daughter of former Black Widow Anna Anokhin and Peter Anokhin—the latter of whom was brutally assassinated by a Red Room operative under the direct orders of Leviathan’s ruthless supreme commander, General Viktor Egorav. During her infancy, the family unit was shattered when Galina was forcefully separated from her mother by Leviathan agents. She was transported to a highly classified, deep-state installation known as the Red Room Academy, earmarked from birth to be engineered into a high-caliber asset for the state.

In 1992, at just three years old, her trajectory was recalibrated when the high-ranking overseer Dreykov selected her for a high-stakes Soviet espionage operation. Galina was assigned to play the younger daughter of deep-cover sleeper agents Alexei Shostakov and Melina Vostokoff, with a young Natasha Romanoff cast as her older sister. Relocated to the domestic landscape of Mount Vernon, Ohio, the team established a flawless front of suburban normalcy. Due to her extreme infancy, Galina remained entirely oblivious to the geopolitical mechanics of the assignment, genuinely believing the manufactured cell to be her true biological family.

=== Bloodbending ===
Blood bending is a form of Waterbending that allows people to manipulate the water inside the muscle and organs of a person, such as their blood.

==== Nailin People ====
The Nailin used bloodbending to hunt animals, never on people, the only one who could use bloodbending was the chief hunter. The position of chief hunter was given to the eldest one who could constantly blood bend (not just under a full moon). They were the last bloodbenders before  Hama, but were almost fully wiped out, the remaining Nailini went on to become the Swamp People, but only brought down plantbending instead of Bloodbending.

Maakris once bloodbent Sai to convince him to kill the Avatar, but never used it afterwards because he thought that it was unnatural and believed he didn’t need to resort to bloodbending to become the most powerful Waterbender

==== Tonzi ====
Tonzi only ever used bloodbending to take away the bending of  Kadra and Maakris.

=== Bonebending ===
Bonebending is a subset of Earthbending that allows you to bend the dirt and earth in someone’s body, most commonly bones, it allows you to control the movement of their joints.

The Baako people lived in the Desert and used discarded bones and lion-turtle shells to build their structures, they found impurities in the bones and bent them, a lot like metal bending. Unlike bloodbending it was learne

== Reviews ==
* I also really enjoyed my read of the the ''Ty Lee Joins the Circus!''. To start with the artwork in this second completed fanon by FlamesOfKaiya is just as remarkable if not better then his first. This story truly is a much needed piece in the Avatar Universe to explain Ty Lee origins and backstory. This comic can absolutely and I think guaranteed to be approved as ''Ty Lee Alone'' if an executive from Avatar Studios ever read this fanon. I enjoy learning how Ty Lee at first dealt with the unique situation of having many identical sisters in her family, especially the way Ty Lee as an individual connected with her mom and dad because of it. The way in which Ty Lee felt to separate from her family upon feeling hurt at being falsely identified by her father very authentic to Ty Lee's character of not wanting to be part of a matched set and desire a form of individuality. Lastly, the way Ty Lee was recruited into the circus felt exactly the way she would handle it. I strongly recommend reading this and FlamesOfKaiya's previous works. === Union of Two Bloods === During the period surrounding Crowned Repat Setka’s marriage to Princess Chu Zi of the Kuiwu Dynasty, Pharaoh Shabaka functioned as both the chief political sponsor of the alliance and the presiding authority over the ceremonial proceedings in Bekini. His actions during this period combined private preparation for succession with public demonstrations of stability intended to legitimize the union between the Isoro Empire and the Oma Kingdom. Prior to the formal events, Shabaka held a private conversation with Setka in which Setka expressed doubts about his readiness to inherit the throne. In response, Shabaka offered reassurance framed around dynastic continuity, self-control, and moral responsibility. During this exchange, Shabaka disclosed that court healers had diagnosed him with Khesef en Hat (“Withering of the Core”), indicating a serious illness that would likely accelerate Setka’s succession. Shabaka treated the disclosure as a matter of practical inheritance planning rather than a public announcement, emphasizing preparation rather than uncertainty. In the diplomatic phase of the wedding, Shabaka hosted Earth King Yeman and Queen-Mother Dai Hau within the palace and formally welcomed them on behalf of the Isoro court

'''Subdominance: Black Ice''' 

Allows the user to create a special form of ice with unique properties. This ice is incredibly resilient, able to withstand severe impacts and extreme changes in temperature. Its main feature, however, is its ability to absorb the light around it, eliminating reflections and completely camouflaging itself in low-light environments. This makes it almost imperceptible to the naked eye, allowing for stealth attacks or unnoticeable traps. In addition to being a lethal combat tool, used to create barriers or weapons that combine brute force and absolute stealth, granting the user a strategic advantage against their opponents.

'''Subdominant: Solar light''' 

Directly channels the sun's energy as a source of power, allowing the user to exploit its intensity for various purposes. During the day, especially in direct sunlight, the user can focus the sun's rays into devastating precision attacks, such as burning beams of light or blasts of concentrated energy. Additionally, exposure to the sun significantly amplifies the user's physical strength and vitality, making them more resilient and powerful in combat.

=== Storm summoning ===
This is a very rare and powerful form of Firebending. Most of the time an Avatar would have to do this, as it usually requires both a Firebender and a Waterbender. Select few Firebenders have done this alone though. The Waterbender would have to use Cloudbending to make some clouds(although strong benders could create a hurricane using Hurricane Creation), and then the Firebender would kickstart a reaction in the clouds, causing lightning to be made. Very skilled Firebenders could be able to aim the lightning, although it is extremely difficult. A Firebender by their self could be able to do this if there is already rain clouds in the sky. Waterbenders cannot do this alone as they are not able to kickstart the reaction in the clouds allowing lightning to form. However, if they are very lucky, a Waterbender could create rain clouds high enough in the sky that lightning will form, but this does not depend on skill and mostly depends on luck. Storm summoning is a very rare type of sub-bending, as a lot of Firebenders and Waterbenders do not know how to use it. If a Firebender was to aim the lightning at something or someone, they have a high chance of missing. This is due to the lack of stability for controlling the lightning. Even some of the strongest Storm Summoners have difficulty controlling the lightning. added_text:
sacrifice. The first and most important rule of turning Asura is that, to make a pact with Vaatu, you must overcome a painful loss. The
Sacrificing a stranger, an enemy, or a disliked person is only acceptable as a sacrifice if the user opposes killing in general: a professional soldier who kills an enemy in battle and uses their blood to turn Asura will not be contacted by Vaatu because that loss wasn't painful to them. In order to gain the most elite technique of each Vaatu element, the sacrifice has to be either the Avatar themselves or a person that the one turning Asura has romantic or familial attachment to.

When the Avatar attempts to turn Asura, Raava will leave their body, causing a new Avatar to be born, while the former Avatar becomes an Asura that can only use the Vaatu counterpart to the element they were born to bend (for instance, had Aang turned Asura, he'd have traded Water, Fire and Earth to get only Mind). An Avatar who's turned Asura has their soul destroyed and is "erased" from the Avatar Cycle, making their soul unable to speak to any future Avatar (so, for instance, had Aang turned Asura, Korra wouldn't have been able to talk to him). 
* Turning Asura is reminiscent of Immediate Retribution Actions

== The ritual to turn Asura ==
To be able to bend Vaatu's four elements, a bender has to get a human sacrifice: the more the user cares about said human sacrifice, the stronger the power granted by Vaatu will be.

In order to turn Asura, a bender needs to use their bending to kill said victim, then drink some of their blood and/or eat some of their flesh, and draw a circle on the forehead using the blood. After that, they must close their eyes, and they will see Vaatu appearing in some sort of vision: Vaatu will ask them "doth thou desire the power?". Saying yes will cause the circle to light up and become indelible, and the user's eyes to turn purple. They have successfully turned Asura and will get their bending upgraded into a Vaatu element.

If a nonbender (using any sort of weapon instead of bending) attempts said ritual, they won't get a Vaatu element, instead their Asura form is a monstrous form that looks like a cross between zombies and the Oni from Japanese folklore, with skin of various colors such as red or green, and horns on the head, and some inhuman feature such as a tail, multiple arms or wings or a bigger size. 

If a Spirit attempts to turn Asura, they don't gain a Vaatu element but take on a more monstrous form.

=== Appearances in Aang's life ===

== Relationships ==
=== Love interest ===
==== Fulung ====
In her youth, Sonam found an Avatar companion in the wayward prince of Ba Sing Se. In her work of protecting innocents and maintaining order. Sonam made an active effort not to her and the prince's shared feelings get in the way of her mission. While in conflict with the Four Pillars, Fulung saw merit in the Four Pillars' vision, but Sonam was not so certain.

=== Allies ===
==== Aang ====
{{Blockquote|Avatar Aang, you are the true embodiment of the Air Nomads. Thank you for giving up the power that I could not. You give me hope for the future of out culture.|{{C|Sonam}}'s response to {{C|Aang}}'s realization about the spirit of the {{C|Air Nomads}}.}}
Around 110 AG, Aang found a statuette of Sonam while collecting ancient Air Nomad relics. When the Denied ambushed him and stole a map hidden inside the figure, Aang was driven to investigate. He was led to the peak of Mount Baihu, where discovered Tagah, who Sonam had sealed thousands of years prior. When the ancient airbender awoke, he and Aang traveled together in search of Sonam's staff forming a brotherly connection. On their journey, Tagah withheld details about his relationship with Sonam, and eventually betrayed and killed Aang. Before being revived by Katara, Aang connected with Sonam, who was distraught to learn that Tagah was once again active and asked Aang what he had done. Overcome with grief
